<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>DIAMETER: 6,485 km</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>MASS: 4.73 x 10e24 kg</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>TERRAIN: Barren</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>TEMPERATURE: -38°C to 69°C</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>ESCAPE VELOCITY: 9.04 km/sec</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Devoid of water, atmosphere or life, Sudbury is a planet whose core cooled eons ago. Nothing of interest was discovered during initial system surveys, with most attention instead focused on its moon. Due to its mass, Sudbury attracts most asteroids that are flung out from the Georgian Ice Field, shielding Blezard Valley from impacts. In 834 AS, a hyperspace pulse was detected in Ontario, originating from Planet Sudbury. This wave bore a striking similarity to the readings detected during the Blackout several years prior, destroying sensitive equipment and sensors throughout the system. An energy field activated on Sudbury’s darkside, partially submerged into the planet’s surface.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Speculation that an ancient facility had awoken at the heart of the field were borne out when artificial structures pushed through the surface's regolith. It soon became apparent that these structures were some form of emitter array, as a vast and sustained beam was projected out into deep space, towards The Barrier. While various factions have struggled to control Sudbury's orbit for access to the anomaly, the LSF have now ousted their rivals by deploying the Battlecruiser Tuscaloosa nearby. Liberty expeditions have begun sinking antimatter blasting charges into boreholes around "Site Alpha", in an attempt to undermine the protective shield.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>The Lane Hacker Spyglass Network was initially severely damaged by the beam's activation pulse, but has since been repaired and begun openly broadcasting data onto the neural net. Liberty neural net scrapers have futilely attempted to suppress the feeds without much success, leading to significant public debate around ancient aliens, Artifact sites, and the dangers they pose. Researchers analyzing the Lane Hacker data believe there were intricate energy fluctuations being transmitted along the now terminated beam, potentially pulsed data or instructions. With the recent impact of the beam in Coronado, debate of this hypothesis has taken on a frenzied edge, as authorities try to anticipate what will occur on the moon Jericho.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

[816 AS] Terrorism Works

466637
NAME
ALAMO -- Encouraged by the recent success that the Mollys in Bretonia have had in getting the Government there to come to the table and talk terms. The Xenos have stepped up their attacks on targets throughout Liberty in the hope of provoking a similar response from the Liberty Government. "We know they are hurting" a spokesman for the Xenos said recently, "For every 3 ships that make it into Liberty, they are losing at least one". The Xenos attacks have recently become Liberty-wide, indicating a degree of organization higher than what was originally believed, Liberty forces, while coping for now are finding themselves increasingly stretched thin by the constant harassment.

466638
NAME
[816 AS] A Problem of Cash Flow

466639
NAME
ALAMO -- Money has always been a problem for the Xenos. A grass roots organization made up of mostly disgruntled lower class workers and their families, the Xenos have never had much of a cash reserve to call upon. Raiding supplements their income, through the sale of stolen parts and commodities, as well as plundering the last remains of silver from the silver fields of Colorado. It is rumoured that they may also have a number of secret beneficiaries within the upper classes of Liberty itself who donate funds and support to the group. Though this has never been proven and no one has ever been formally charged in this area.

466640
NAME
[816 AS] Someone on the Inside

466641
NAME
ALAMO -- Xenos have no shortage of manpower. As the number of dissatisfied workers in Liberty grows owing to the Governments economic policies there, so to do ranks of the Xenos. Their brand of simple politics and nationalism is an attractive drawcard for many among the millions of bitter and angry out of work people of Liberty. The prison stations of Texas also provide a reservoir of hardened recruits, where the Xenos are aided by insiders in the LPI itself, who are always eager to make a quick buck under the table.

466642
NAME
[816 AS] Xenos Stand Alone

466643
NAME
ALAMO -- Or do they? Recent reports have indicated a level of tolerance shown to some non-Liberty factions from the Xenos themselves. Particularly the Zoners and the IMG. Speculation about possible attempts at real diplomacy from the Xenos might be premature however, as indicated in comments made during a recent Xeno pirate radio broadcast in New York. "We don't need anyone else in Liberty" the speaker said, "We look after our own. We won't go trashing through someone else's backyard, but we don't welcome others coming and trashing through ours".

466644

[816 AS] A Ready Made Army

466645
NAME
ALAMO -- The desperate Liberty citizens that join the Xenos bring with them a multitude of skills and abilities. Ranging from technicians to Doctors, Priests to labourers there is no shortage of ability within the ranks. "It's not technical skill we lack" said a Xeno spokesman, "That we have plenty of, if your ship is damaged, we have ample people who can fix it, it's the parts to fix it with that we sometimes lack".\n\nThe fickle nature of supply and the deep pool of talent has made the Xenos skilled improvisers and well versed in "making do". Skills which will be needed if they ever hope to achieve their political aims in the face of the stiff and determined resistance from the Liberty military.

Once Rheinland reunited however, it quickly became apparent that holding the world would be untenable and the Kassel was forced to fight a retreating battle while providing cover for evacuees leaving the planet. Having succeeded in its objective, the Kassel now sits at Wolfsburg Shipyard undergoing repairs from its fight with the Altenburg before going back into action.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

Stolen Diamonds are then used to supplement the depleted stocks of Dresden and sold on the black market to fund the movement. Freital is also vital to blocking Corsair advances into Stuttgart and protecting the supply lines from Dresden to Omega-5. Hessian pilots serving on the brutal Ronneburg front line are often rotated back to Freital to rest, while still being close enough to respond to Corsair breakthroughs as a strategic reserve.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>In 822 AS, the Hessians were forced to abandon Freital after the system’s red giant entered a period of extreme activity, producing devastating solar flares that destroyed ships and destabilized local Jump Holes. While some speculated that this may have been a prelude to the dying star’s collapse, the activity subsided to relatively “safe” levels over the next three years. During that period, the Hessian supply lines to Omega-5 were stretched to breaking point, as longer and more dangerous routes from Dresden were required. Ronneburg nearly fell at several points before Freital was restored in late 825 AS.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Since 833 AS, the base has been forced to cut the number of reinforcements supplied to Omega-5 due to the Corsair attack on Dresden. In recent months, Vogtland has turned the tide in that battle, freeing Freital’s squadrons to support the Battleship Zuschen’s daring counter-attack on the Corsair flank in Omega-41.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

469374
NAME
[832 AS] Bautzen Station and Strausberg destroyed!

469375
NAME
DRESDEN -- 832 AS -- A successful blitz attack has been launched against the Bautzen Station by Cruiser Heppenheim and its escort wing! Bautzen Station went down in flames, along with most of its crew - deservingly so for their continued defiance against us. While Heppenheim was lost with all hands to the Battleship Strausberg's immediate counter-attack, it managed to disrupt the enemy fleet long enough for our bomber wings to retaliate. The Strausberg was damaged beyond the possibility of repair, with its cowardly crew scuttling rather than fighting to the death. The enraged Rheinwehr has foolishly sent what remained of their forces to try and destroy Leipzig, but only managing to disable the station before the Kassel and its escorts arrived. Those invaders were promptly dispatched, with operations on Leipzig Station expected to resume in short order.

469376
NAME
[832 AS] Breaking the Stalemate

469377
NAME
PETRA -- 832 AS -- Grinding stalemates against the Hessians in Omega-5 and Omega-47 have gone on for decades, with tens of thousands having met their end in these systems. High Elder Montoya once pioneered the Road to Rheinland strategy to break this impasse. He envisioned an assault through the Sigmas into Rheinland, crippling the Hessian back lines in Dresden. While the High Elder has since passed, today we have the power to once again put his bold plan into action. Our scouts aboard the Battlecruiser Penitence report that the Rheinland Military and Hessians have severely bloodied one another in clashes across Dresden. Both are weakened and preoccupied; all we must do is administer the fatal blow. The Elders have directed our forces to assemble at Petra and prepare to break through Frankfurt into Dresden. Be wary of the Bundschuh, who have harassed our raiders and resupply freighters in the area. They will likely try to stop us, and are to be shot on sight.

469378
NAME
[832 AS] New Threats, Old Foes

469379
NAME
DRESDEN -- 832 AS -- The Red Hessians have attempted to expand their control over the Dresden system. This time, their target was the Bautzen Station, used to extract precious Blue Diamonds, often referred to as "Hessian Tears". Their merciless ambush was so quick, that the Battleship Strasberg stationed in the system was unable to respond in time, and the only survivors was the quarter of the crew that made it to the escape pods before the station depressurized. Strasberg has, however, managed to catch the Hessians before they've managed to slip away, taking out their 'flagship' in quick order. Admiral Schwarz has ordered the forces under his command to press the advantage, and led his forces towards Leipzig, a former Daumann installation that was taken over by the Hessians over a decade ago. The Admiral's quick decision-making allowed our brave forces to heavily cripple the Hessian presence in the system, possibly sufficiently to drive them out of the system entirely.\n\nThe victory did not come without a price, however: The main reactor of Strausberg suffered heavy damage during the battle and the ship had to be abandoned after having it's functional components stripped out. Admiral Schwarz in an interview earlier today stressed that the situation in the system is definitely an improvement after the recent events, and that the Hessian defeat in the system is imminent. In other news, various projects for Bautzen's replacement are already being discussed.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>The basic components of H-Fuel are Hydrogen, Deuterium and Helium-3. The amount of Hydrogen to the Helium-3 and Deuterium content determines how enriched the mixture is. Different engines require a different mixture - generally, the bigger the engine or reactor, the purer the mixture can be. Since all the isotopes are stable, H-Fuel will not decay under normal circumstances, and can be stored indefinitely - unlike the fuel Gallia is rumored to use. It will react chemically with oxygen, since a large portion of the fuel consists of hydrogen isotopes. The main gas we mine for in the Crow is Helium-3. It forms as a byproduct of stellar fusion, and isn't normally found in a nebula. Why the Crow is so rich in this isotope has been subject of much scientific debate, but the Gas Miners Guild has built their fortunes on this anomaly. We use more Deuterium then we can extract from the Crow, so we actually import that isotope from elsewhere in Sirius. </TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

478708
NAME
Role Play

478709
INFOCARD
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>Roleplay improves the game experience by creating an immersive universe that lets all players entertain through creativity.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>To roleplay means playing the role of a character living in Sirius, whose biography you defined. Their personality may differ largely from your own. Be a hero, anti-hero, leader, disciple, back-stabbing crook, gung-ho soldier, artificial intelligence, money-groping capitalist, weirdo, multi-faceted and complex, or simple-minded. If you want to roleplay personalities similar to Han Solo, Jean-Luc Piccard, or Orillion, please do but use different names to stay immersive and original.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>To keep role play realistic and fair, you shouldn't do things that your character realistically wouldn't do, or wouldn't know. For example, don't be a Liberty Navy pilot who defends pirates against the forces of the law. Don't use knowledge you acquired on your Corsair character to bust an artifact smuggler on your Police character. </TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Roleplay consists of spoken words and of actions such as firing weapons. Be tolerant of players who enjoy either the story-telling or the space combat game aspects more than you. If you favor talking over shooting, it's up to you to avoid situations where you're destined to get shot at. If you enjoy combat, it's up to you to respect the required roleplay context and server rules. Space is both fascinating, and dangerous.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

478710
NAME
Trading

478711
INFOCARD
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>Trading is a straight-forward method to increase wealth. Most players have one or more trade ships they transfer credits to other ships from (see "Cash Transfer" for info). Ships with larger holds bring larger profits per trip, but have less maneuverability and therefore more vulnerability to pirates. Be sure to read your ID so you don't violate its cargo size restrictions. Enter /stuck if you are stuck in a base or asteroids with a large ship.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>By landing on unexplored stations and planets, you'l learn about more trade routes (seen by clicking the "Trade Routes" icon in the commodity information). A good way to maximize your profits is to join trade factions who'll assist you in finding profitable routes and the best ships.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Armed escorts and scouts can protect you against pirates, but if you're still robbed of credits or cargo, quench your thirst for revenge by placing a bounty (see Bounty Boards on discoverygc.com/forums). Most of the time, sweet-talking yourself out of a stick-up or paying the pirate are cheaper alternatives than trying to run. Disconnecting from the server to escape piracy will result in sanction, as piracy and antagonists are an important part of the game and role play. </TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Trade runs are a great time to chat with potential business partners, read all help topics, or use LEFT-TAB + RETURN for windowed mode and visit discoverygc.com. Trading in windowed mode works best if you set the game resolution lower than your desktop resolution in the game launcher. Browsing the internet while playing may cause severe lag and disconnections on low bandwidth connections.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

478712
NAME
Mining

478713
INFOCARD
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>Shooting the small moving asteroids with mining lasers in areas marked yellow by the navmap's pickax symbol will generate mineral ore in cargo holds. Gas is mined by shooting moving particles in the exhaust of gas mining facilities. Using mining lasers on a mining ship with mining IDs will boost efficiency and generate more ore per hit. The more parallel mining turrets you have, the bigger the bonus. Mining factions will be glad to help you set up an efficient miner if you join them.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>If you target another player's ship within 1k distance while mining, the ore is automatically transferred to that ship's cargo hold (unless your IDs are incompatible). Working as a miner/hauler team with one miner and one large transport is the most time-efficient way to make credits.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Ore drop rates also depend on the individual ID and field characteristics. Some yellow-marked fields no longer yield ore, so ask for help from experienced miners if you don't get any for unknown reasons. More information can be found in the Discovery Mining Guide at discoverygc.com.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

478716
NAME
Reputation

478717
INFOCARD
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>Your reputation affects whether bases let you dock and buy equipment, bar characters talk to you, NPCs attack you, the color of radar contacts, and your own Identify Friend-Foe (IFF) tag. Other players see your IFF tag in front of your name in their targeting computer.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>View your reputation with the factions you've met using the man-shaped symbol in the top right corner or the F8 key. Killing NPCs (not players) lowers your rep with their faction, while fulfilling missions for them raises it. Grouping with players while they accomplish missions affects your rep even if you don't actively partake. Raising reputation with a faction also raises it with their allies and lowers it with enemies.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>A very friendly reputation is needed to join a faction by buying its ID. Having a faction's ID mounted will force the rep of its enemies/allies to friendly/hostile when you launch. You'll adopt the faction's IFF when friendliest to them. The faction name will flash yellow once you've adopted their IFF, and players will see you as affiliated with it. Typing /droprep will drop the reputation of your current IFF, and replace it with the next best friendly faction.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

478720
NAME
COMBAT

478721
INFOCARD
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>You can improve your ship with armor, weapons, shields, and thrusters, but skill and tactics determine the outcome of most fights. Even the best equipped battleship can be helpless against small craft that are too agile to hit and too fast to pursue or to escape from. It's recommended to train combat early on using small craft to get a grasp of tactics and game mechanics. You can train fighting against other players in the out-of-roleplay Connecticut system (type /conn while docked to get there and /return to get back to Sirius), and practice the basic skills explained in the Help System against NPCs.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Learn to dodge fire by using thruster (TAB key), randomly changing direction, and strafing (A and D). Quick-docking with Trade Lanes and Jump Gates (fly to the right spot before pressing F3) will save you from receiving damage in lengthy docking sequences. Cruise disruptors keep enemies from escaping, but also detonate nearby mines, torpedoes, and missiles. </TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>The better pilot wins most fights, not the biggest ship. Building skill requires practice, and there are many tricks that experienced pilots are willing to teach players who work with them. Combat can also be learned through written and video tutorials available at discovery.com/forums (look in the pinned "A Pretty Helpful Tutorial Database" post in the Tutorials sub-forum).</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

478722
NAME
Survival

478723
INFOCARD
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>The most important asset for survival is to know how to not get hit by enemy shots. In order to dodge projectiles, change your vector often by:</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>-turning while thrusting (hold down the TAB key to thrust and move the mouse from one edge of the screen to another in a circular pattern)</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>-strafing in alternate directions (move horizontally using A and D keys or vertically using customized controls)</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>-altering speed with thrust and reverse-thrust (useful in some situations but dangerous in others) </TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Pressing TAB to thrust will make your turns more effective at dodging fire, but keep an eye on your thruster's energy so you don't become a sitting duck when it runs out. Learning to Engine-Kill will help you conserve its energy (see "Engine Kill" help). Keep in mind that dodging fire becomes easier with greater distance and slower projectiles. Turning (mouse movements) while thrusting is the most effective way to dodge when you aren't shooting at an enemy yourself, but strafing lets you avoid enemy fire while still aiming and firing in front of you at the same time. Using reverse thrust and making a sharp turn at the same time can shake an enemy off your tail, but can get you hit even more when done in the wrong situation.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>It's best to practice survival techniques in places guarded by hostile NPCs, so you know how to survive when it really counts. The more agile and smaller your ship is, the better it is at dodging fire, which is why small craft often survive longer than large ones in Player vs Player fights (see the "Tactics" help). Light Fighters are nearly impossible to hit when flown by skilled pilots, while Heavy Fighters, Very Heavy Fighters, and bombers are balanced for agility, firepower, and hit points.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Purchasable armor upgrades will multiply your ship's base armor by a certain factor so it can survive more hits. Be sure to mount the armor in an engine shop on a station so you don't lose it when you die. Armor upgrades make the nanobot repair (used by pressing the G key) more effective by the same factor. Use of shield batteries (used by pressing the F key) is best saved for moments when your shield is completely down and you know you'll unavoidably get hit more before it can regenerate, and similar emergencies. Use your nanobots as soon as you took damage to hull, but save shield batteries for dire situations because shields regenerate with time while hull doesn't. Learning skills like quick-docking with lanes, gates, and stations will not only get you hit less while docking, but also allows for faster travel while trading (see "Quick Dock" help).</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

478724
NAME
Quick Dock

478725
INFOCARD
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>Docking sequences with lanes, gates, stations, and planets can be made nearly instantaneous if docking is initiated by pressing the F3 key while being in the right place. </TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>The optimal location for Trade Lane docking is close before the center of the lane ring that points towards the direction you want to travel. The red/green lights in the corners indicate the direction of the ring. The optimal docking location for Jump Gates is shortly before the small round opening in the closed "claws". Jump holes are best docked with while you are directly in them, except certain large slow ships for which the best moment to press F3 is shortly before entering the hole. </TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Stations commonly have quick dock points near airlocks (grey squares) or tower lights. Planets have their quick dock points, which unlike docking rings also service large ships, at the mooring fixtures near the rings. Player Owned Bases (POBs) have quick dock points slightly above and below the central docking hangar.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

478726
NAME
Gun Stats

478727
INFOCARD
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>Consider all the attributes when choosing the right gun or turret. Guns which excel in one attribute generally have deficits in the others.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>-Speed: Faster projectiles increase the likelihood to hit the target, because it leaves less time for it to change vector and avoid the shot.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>-Re-fire Rate: Higher fire rate raises your hit rate on small targets, leaving them less time to regenerate shields.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>-Range: Being able to fire at longer ranges gives you an agility advantage if your target is too large and slow to dodge shots even at a distance.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>-Energy Efficiency (damage per energy): Higher energy efficiency lets you deal more damage before your energy is drained.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>-Hull Damage per Second (hull damage x fire rate): Often thought to be the most important characteristic of a gun. But also consider that slow projectile speed will make a lot of your shots miss small agile targets, and that energy efficiency matters especially when you drain your power to zero by firing continually. Hull damage is only dealt if the target's shield is down.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>-Shield Damage: Certain types of guns deal heavy damage to shields and almost none to hull. These guns are useful to raise energy efficiency by splitting weapons into "Shield Buster" and "Hull Buster" groups that are selected depending on whether the target's shields are up or down (see the "Weapon Group" help).</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

478728
NAME
Weapon Group

478729
INFOCARD
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>Splitting weapons into groups can improve tactics, energy efficiency, and aim.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>To create weapons groups activated by number keys (above the letter keys), open the F1 menu and select "Options", then "Controls". Then go to "User Interface" and scroll down to assign the number keys to "Activate Weapons Group" 0 through 9. The number keys will now activate weapons groups on all your characters and all accounts, so this step is needed only once on every computer you use.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>To assign or un-assign certain weapons to a group, press the number key to select the group, then click on the weapons in the lower right window to activate (green) or de-activate (light blue) them. Pressing this number key will now de-activate or activate weapons according to what you assigned to the group. Be sure to have weapon group 1 activated while docking (or dying), or group 1 and the active group will be over-written because of a game bug.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>The most common use of weapons groups in both small craft like fighters/bombers ("snubs") as well as capital ships like cruisers and battleships ("caps") is to separate guns that do more damage to shields and hull (see the "Gun Choice" help). This allows you to quickly switch weapon type depending on whether the target's shield is up or down. A widespread way to do this is to have group 1 with both "hullbusters" and "shieldbusters" active (quickly takes down enemy shields when your energy reserve is high), group 2 "hullbuster"-only (used when the enemy's shield is down) and group 3 "shieldbuster"-only (used when the enemy's shield is up and your energy reserve is low).</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>In multi-turret capital ships, you'll also want to separate guns with fast projectile speed (for defense against close fast moving targets) and guns with slow speed but high damage output and range (for heavily armored slow moving targets at greater distance). Having guns with different projectile speed activated at the same time will make the targeting cross-hair inaccurate. </TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

478730
NAME
Engine Kill

478731
INFOCARD
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>One of the most important techniques used by skilled pilots is to shut off the engine and let the ship drift freely.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Its uses include saving thruster energy, firing multiple Cruise Disruptors (CDs) while maintaining cruise speed, out-maneuvering your opponent in dog-fights, and firing without getting in the way of your wingmen in group fights. </TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Go to the F1 Options/Controls Menu and assign Engine Kill to a key that is easy to reach without moving your hand from the A,S,D, and W keys (mostly used are X, Y, or Z depending on your keyboard). Engine kill only works when "goto" (F2) or "dock" (F3) aren't activated. Press the Engine Kill key and you should hear the sound of the engine being turned off. Then press and release the thrust or strafe keys, and you should keep drifting in the same direction even after releasing the trust/strafe key, and even when turning your ship in another direction with the mouse. Pressing the Accelerate or Decelerate keys turns the engine back on.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>You can use Engine Kill to move at thrust speed for an unlimited amount of time without draining thruster energy, by keeping your engine off and tapping the thrust key from time to time. You can also dodge enemy fire doing this, if you turn in different directions while pressing thrust.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Engine Kill also works while cruising, which is useful for firing cruise disruptors (CDs) at a fleeing target without having to slow down. However, being hit by a cruise disruptor yourself also nullifies your engine kill, making it an effective counter to many Engine Kill tactics.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Killing your engine to keep drifting in one direction while turning your ship around is a good way to get an enemy into your gun sights during 1 on 1 fights. This technique also lets you lose pesky NPCs because they stop following you when you do it for long enough. Keep in mind that you're easy to hit when drifting in a straight line, so avoid doing it at the wrong moment.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>When done right, engine kill allows you to out-turn your opponents in a way that keeps you out of their gun sights. Check the PvP Tutorials on discovery.gc and practice this technique if you want to become a dog-fighting ace.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

478732
NAME
Cruise-Disrupt

478733
INFOCARD
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>In addition to the main function of keeping an enemy from fleeing, cruise disruptors can be used as offensive and defense weapons. They detonate mines and missiles within their blast range, and can thus detonate them prematurely. This technique is sometimes called "Counter Cruise Disrupting" or CCD. CD hits also keep an enemy from cloaking as long as the cloak is still charging, and from using Engine Kill.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Cruise Disruptors have excellent homing capabilities, and therefore dropping multiple Counter Measures (CMs) is recommended when trying to escape them. </TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>CDs with large blast radius are more effective at stopping large ships, but tend to make NPCs hostile to you more if they get caught in the blast. Using a Mosquito CD which has a small blast radius can help avoid making friendly NPCs hostile.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

478734
NAME
Tactics

478735
INFOCARD
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>Fighting experienced players is very different from fighting NPCs which only have limited artificial intelligence. The most important lesson to learn is that owning the biggest, best armored, and best-equipped ship won't automatically mean you will win or survive. The most likely winners are players who correctly assess the situation, who know the limitations of their ships, and who possess the right skills and strategies. </TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Fast and agile craft will always be able to escape without being killed by slower ships, unless they make the mistake of coming too close. It's therefore recommended you become a halfway decent fighter/bomber pilot before you get an expensive ship of which you don't know the capabilities and limitations. Even if you prefer large ships, learning to fight "caps" in "snubs" will teach you the basic combat dynamics early on. Learn techniques like dodging fire and grouping weapons. Observe and train how every snub or cap weapon is used most effectively.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>A good way to quickly learn useful aspects of the game and have fun with friends is to join an existing player faction. Player factions commonly have prefixes (tags) like "Order|" or "K'Hara-" in front of their names, so feel free to ask tagged ships if their faction is recruiting. You can find more information about player factions at discoverygc.com/forum, in the "Faction" section.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Don't forget that the goal of the game isn't to win every fight, but to have fun. Disrespecting players (not role play characters) and poor role play will often result in people wanting to see you explode to get rid of you. But don't expect to not be attacked just because your own role-play is friendly or "good", as conflict and combat are important elements of role-play. Making friends instead of enemies (in and out of roleplay) is the best tactic for achieving a good gaming experience.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>1. COMMUNITY RULES</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>1.1 This is a Freelancer-based role-play community. Character names and behavior must be realistic in the Discovery Freelancer universe (no player nationality tags, memes, pop-culture references, or direct imports from other universes like Star Wars). Realistic role-play also means that characters can't use information they didn't receive in the game universe.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>1.2 Don't insult, harass, or threaten players outside of role-play. Don't use racist, graphic, pornographic, obscene, or law-violating materials in or out of role-play. Don't repeatedly target specific players or groups with the intention of ruining their game experience. Don't mislead players about rules or pose as an admin or "admin friend" to gain an advantage.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>1.3 Everything must be in understandable English. Some non-English words can enhance role-play, but the meanings should be kept understandable to English-only speakers.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>2. SERVER GAMEPLAY</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>2.1 Out-Of-Character (OOC) chat should be avoided in local and system chat. Using // in front of OOC messages is recommended.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>2.2 A character/ship must use one single ID and follow the permissions and restrictions of ID, ship, and equipment infocards. </TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>2.3 Players using Recruit ID and players below level 30 may not be attacked unless they: attack first, fire cruise-disruptors, refuse to stop stalking, carry a codename weapon, or take active part in role-play.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>2.4 All attacks must be a result of roleplay. Players must say more than one line and give reasonable time for the opponent to react before initiating an attack. Non-Nomads may always attack Nomads, but role-play is still required. See rule 5.1 before attacking a Player Owned Base.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>2.5 If you die in any way during PvP, you must leave the system the fight took place in and not re-enter it on any characters for two hours. You may not carry cargo, engage in player interactions, or be attacked while leaving. You also can't attack the player(s) you died to on any of your characters for two hours. </TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>2.6 The same as 2.5 applies if you dock within 15K of your enemy while in PvP, with the exceptions that you may re-enter the system to trade, keep your cargo, and players may attack you while you're leaving the system.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>2.7 Demands should be reasonable and only one monetary or cargo demand can be issued during each piracy interaction.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>2.8 Don't disconnect in space to escape interaction. If you get disconnected, log back on immediately and apologize to the players you were interacting with. If you can't apologize ingame, do so in the forum thread titled "DISCONNECTED". Don't rejoin a fight without permission from your adversary after getting disconnected. </TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>2.9 Connecticut is a system where players aren't required to role-play and may only attack with the adversary's consent. Bastille is a system that imprisons rule breakers until they agree to obey server rules.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

478757

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>3. HIRED GUNS AND BOUNTIES</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>3.1 All contracts and bounties must be justified within roleplay and conform to IDs. A character may be hired ingame or on the forum by non-generic IDed (non Freelancer, Pirate, or miner) players, for a minimum of 1 million credits per target. Targets must be informed of the contract/bounty originator before the attack. The reputations of employer and employee must be neutral or friendly to each other, and they must both be hostile to the target.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>3.2 Bounties and contracts made while the employer is offline or PvP-dead must be posted in the "Bounty Offices" sub-forum. Employers must specify their name and affiliation, and also specify and verify the affiliation of those who may claim the bounty. A limited payout number, expiry date, or exclusivity to pre-registered bounty board members may be specified beforehand. Players may not hire exclusively their own characters. </TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>3.3 Forum-Bounties on factions instead of named individuals (blanket bounties) may only be issued (or sponsored within roleplay) by official factions and governments. These may also be compensated through flat rate payments of at least 30 million credits per month to individuals or factions. Non-generic IDed unofficial factions may sponsor internal blanket bounties for members of their player or NPC faction only.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>3.4 Attacking someone for non-existing contracts or non-claimable bounties, as well as not visibly claiming payment within 7 days of an alleged forum-bounty kill, will result in sanction. Payments must be made within two weeks of a legitimate claim.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>4. FACTIONS</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>4.1 Players may create a faction for any publicly available ID they want, if the faction uses a single ID, IFF, and tag. Every faction must have one leader and at least one second-in-command who speak for it. It's recommended but optional for unofficial factions to post descriptions in the Unofficial Factions and Groups sub-forum, explaining their background, diplomacy, goals, and to ask for community feedback. It's also recommended to create roleplay message logs on the forum.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>4.2 Official status is awarded following the "Achieving Official Faction Status" post on the forum. Official Factions (OFs) must have a public feedback thread they answer to on the forum. They have the following Official Faction Rights (OFRs). All instances of OFR use must be documented by forum roleplay.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>-OFR 1: OF leaders ranked first or second in command have in-roleplay authority over characters of the same NPC affiliation, regarding diplomacy and strategic/tactical direction. They may not require anyone to follow non-canon or unreasonable roleplay. Disobeying legitimate orders may result in roleplay consequences such as ingame arrest, court-martial, and in extreme cases ingame force.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>-OFR 2: OFs who planned an event with at least 24 hours notice on the forum can restrict the participation of others in that event. It shouldn't severely limit another faction's activities in their own ZoI or provide unfair protection from logical roleplay consequences.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>-OFR 3: OFs may request that the reputation of a player's ship be set hostile towards their NPC faction, by posting in the appropriate Violation Reports sub-forum. They must provide evidence of forum roleplay and interaction between the OF and the character. Ships subjected to OFR3 may treat ships of the issuing faction (except transports) as hostile targets.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>-OFR 4: OFs may bounty or attack a player who uses their affiliation's technology without the faction ID nor official permission, regardless of their diplomacy with the user's faction. Permissions may only be given by an OF affiliated with the manufacturer of the technology, and must be documented in roleplay on the forum.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>5. PLAYER OWNED BASES</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>5.1 Dealing more damage to a Player Owned Base (POB) than needed to prevent a ship from docking must be preceded by forum roleplay and a post in the Attack Declaration Thread at least 8 hours (core 1 bases) or 24 hours (core 2 and higher) prior to the attack. Attack declarations are valid for 2 weeks.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>5.2 No roleplay is required prior to building a Core 1 base, but it must make sense in roleplay. Name, location and IFF of bases are permanent and can't be changed after construction. Bases within 15k distance of mining fields may not advance beyond Core 2. Core upgrades have requirements listed in the "Player Owned Base Upgrades" forum thread.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>5.3 POBs are destructible when unprotected, so it's recommended you inform yourself about House laws and fees and local diplomacy in order to build in a well protected location. POBs in systems bordering House space may not be engaged by House forces for lack of payment of fees, but can still fall prey to other factions.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>6. CHEATING</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>The following cheats and exploits are forbidden:</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>6.1 Modifying your Discovery Freelancer installation, using third-party tools, or abusing glitches/bugs in order to gain advantages over other players.</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>6.2 Running the game with framerates above 155fps. Computers running uncapped framerate must use a third party program to limit the FPS to below 155.</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>6.3 Using cruise disruptors or missiles in order to track a ship that has successfully cloaked.</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>6.4 Intentionally ramming a capital ship in order to ''flip'' it or ''catapult'' your ship away from it.</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>6.5 Suicide trading and intentionally self/team-killing during Combat-Event-Plugin battles in order to prevent the opponent from scoring points.</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>6.6 Connecting to the server with more than one character at a time (Multiboxing). Players sharing a network connection may not engage in trading/mining at the same time.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

Admins are obliged to:</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>-Safeguard the community, server, and forums.</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>-Be fair and treat all players equally.</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>-Not mix server roleplaying with server administration in any way.</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>-Not ignore reported rule violations.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>7.2 Depending on severity and amount of rule violations, sanctions can range from a warning, credit fine, loss of equipment, probation periods with removal of certain privileges, and bans of varying duration. Playing Discovery Freelancer as a community is less anonymous than other games, and therefore things are often taken more personal. Don't attempt to use violation reports for personal revenge. If you're angry, take time to gather and present the evidence properly and make sure you're not mistaken when you're calm.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

[825 AS] Kusari Declares War! Speech by Yukihara Reijiro, Prime Minister

479028
NAME
NEW TOKYO -- 825 AS -- No more than a month ago I addressed this Noble House with our intention to bring a new future to this new region of space, this new member of our family of stars. Shizuoka. Before that, we of Kusari expressed concern and sadness upon witnessing the discord that had befallen our neighbors of Rheinland, and the corporate heads of the Gas Miners Guild, that threatened the stability of the region and could eventually put in danger our House and our people's way of life.\n\nWith effort, we established a security corridor linking to Rheinland, and pledged to both conflicting sides that we would do the utmost to prevent the bloodshed in the Sigma-59 system, ensuring free traffic and relief from the strains of war that would engulf the rest of the sector, unless the House of Rheinland made efforts to sit at the negotiations table with the Guild to settle for peace. We hoped for intelligent heads to prevail, to see the demerits of a prolonged war, of a vague quest for vengeance and grievances that were well below the amount of wrath that the Rheinland spirit demonstrated. We expected that they would know who they were looking for, fighting for, defending from.\n\nWe were ignorant. No, Kusari demonstrated a naiveite that has become too common in its complacency. By believing in our apparent strength and the pride we hold for ourselves, we made ourselves victims to Rheinland Military, who blinded by bloodshed, had forgotten who was their enemy. From seeking justice to just meeting any other human being they found on the battlefield with their destructive force, they struck. And they struck those who held no blame.\n\nOn the past day, KNF local forces had confirmed our suspicions that the Rheinland Military had indiscriminately attacked and annihilated joint Kishiro and GMG civilian installations part of the Shizuoka Colonial Commission project to colonize the Planet Saigon, as it is commonly known. Neither Kishiro or GMG units were of military flair, and all transponders were clearly identified as a civilian operation, just a dozen clicks away from KNF sanctioned security corridor. It is with sadness that we have confirmed the death of Commissioner Akemi Yamashita, senior Kishiro executive and well known promoter of Kusari economy and society development for many years.\n\nRheinland Military, without quarter, attacked these installations, destroyed these peaceful efforts for progress. They ignored the pleas for mercy, and then expected the Kusari Naval Forces to stand idle before this onslaught. They were not idle.\n\nUpon confirming the destruction of Kishiro Survey Vessel Unzen, Kusari Naval Forces took the initiative of retaliation against RM breach of the peace of the Shizuoka system, and notified the government of these horrible crimes. The Diet of Kusari has just now through its processes condemned the actions of the House of Rheinland, validated the Naval Forces actions of retaliation, and pressed further.\n\nBy decision of the Diet of the Reformed Kusari Empire, and by the name of our august Emperor, the House of Kusari has entered a state of war with Rheinland. Such state and any special provisions related with it will remain, until Rheinland ceases all military activities in the Sigma cluster, agrees to withdraw from the Shizuoka system, and accepts the necessity of sitting down to negotiate peace with the Gas Miners Guild and the people of Kusari.\n\nFurthermore, due to the crisis situation in the Shizuoka system, the mandate of the Shizuoka Colonial Comission is suspended for a yet undetermined period, and the control of the affairs of the system placed under the military command of the Shogun Ikeada Yamato, as commanded by the Emperor.\n\nWe hope that our people remain strong and vigilant against the threats to our House, and that together we prevail against the challenges ahead of us. Kusari will prevail.

[826 AS] War Over Curacao

479070
NAME
CURACAO -- 826 AS -- The Allied Forces struck a costly, yet decisive blow to the Gallic Royal Navy today, after a multi-day protracted battle over the shipping lanes of Cortez and, ultimately, the fate of those desperate for supplies on New London.\n\nAllied operations were undertaken by a combined task group of the Liberty's Alma and Yukon battlegroups, as well as the Bretonian's Harlow battlegroup, with light support from the Crayterian Military. Arrayed against them was the Gallic battleship Betheny and its attendant craft, as well as a raiding party of Corsairs who came to the Royal Navy's aid shortly into the fight.\n\nThe Gallic battleship Betheny was the latest in a long line of attempts by the Royal Navy to significantly hamper the supply lines of Libertonian war materiel entering Bretonia. Even with the deployment of Liberty's Yukon, relief supplies were just as likely to be seized by Gallic raids or destroyed outright as were to safely travel make it into Manchester. The Alberta-Poole jump corridor had made the route largely supplemental, but with the loss of that corridor and the ever-growing threat of New London coming under siege, this long-brewing stalemate became an intense focus for the war planners on both sides, and the Allies were the first to act with the deployment of the Harlow and Alma into Cortez.\n\nThe first few days of battle proceeded at range. The battlegroups' smaller, lighter craft fought over and over in a large-scale stalemate between the deadlocked warships, each side hoping to gain the advantage in indirect fighting. After the fourth day ended in another inconclusive draw, however, the Allied Forces recalled their lighter craft and readied to enter into a close range engagement. According to representatives from the Liberty Navy, the Allies had feared the Betheny might escape should they delay further, or that an unseen savior might come to rescue the vessel before it could be put to rest.\n\nThe charge was led by the Libertonian battleship Yukon and its attendant battlegroup. The Alma followed not so distantly in its wake, with the Bretonian Harlow bringing up the rear. According to a source within the Allied military command, the captain and crew of the Yukon moved to engage ahead of the scheduled assault, believing that the Betheny was preparing to withdraw before they had planned to attack.\n\nThe resultant clash could be seen quite clearly from Curacao's surface, a spectacle which has already lit up the social neural-nets. The Yukon and Betheny engaged in a close-quarters melee, duelling with high-powered weaponry. The Alma quickly moved in to bracket the vessel, attempting to take her down before the Yukon suffered critical damage. The Harlow, however, remained outside the effective range of the Betheny's main cannon, offering primarily bomber support against the Gallic capital ship from distance.\n\nDespite the valiant efforts of the Allies and the Royal Navy, however, both the Yukon and the Betheny fell to hostile fire with all hands. The vast majority of the Betheny's attached battlegroup were destroyed outright, although some managed to escape deeper into the system, along with their allies in the Corsairs. A good portion of the Yukon's escort elements were also lost before they could be reinforced by the Alma's, and the surviving remainder under Rear Admiral Jack Yeager have since been attached to the Alma pending reassignment, Navy representatives told the CNS. Both Harlow and Alma themselves suffered non-critical damage in the fighting, and they have been noted to be receiving materiel from naval logistics vessels in Curacao orbit since the fighting ended.\n\nA joint allied statement has called the operation an unequivocal success, whilst simultaneously lamenting the lives lost, especially aboard the Yukon. Representatives from Orbital Spa & Cruise were quick to applaud the cessation of fighting within the sector, and told the CNS they were hopeful that this would be the start of Curacao's rebuilding and growth after being struck by the war so directly. For the first time in over three years, traffic advisories posted by Interspace Commerce have dropped to "caution", the lowest level posted since the destruction of San Diego Border Station. For those watching the skies on New London, this news comes none too soon.\n\nWe will keep you updated as the situation throughout the war front develops. This is the Colony News Service.\n\nWar Correspondent Alexander Cooper

Almost overnight, Rheinland corporations began opening “virtual offices” and laundering vast sums of credits through them. Intense corporate lobbying has so far prevented the Reichstag from correcting its mistake, while also providing the Freeport with a political shield that keeps suspicious RFP investigators at bay.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>DIAMETER: 13,534 km.</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>MASS: 6.02 x 10e24 kg.</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>TERRAIN: Barren</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>TEMPERATURE: -70°C to 50°C</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>ESCAPE VELOCITY: 12.69 km/sec</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT> </TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>Planet Primus is a desolate world with a thin nitrogen atmosphere, situated within the habitable zone around a star in the Omicron Kappa system. Unlike Planet Gammu, Primus boasts its own magnetic field, which largely shields its surface and delicate atmosphere from solar winds. Although the planet's surface boasts rich deposits of nickel, copper, aluminum, and cobalt, the planet's complex geological conditions and the absence of a comprehensive supporting infrastructure render large-scale surface mining virtually unfeasible. As a result, the planet remained largely untouched by the Artificial Intelligences of Gammu throughout its existence, with attention only turning to it, following the successful Core invasion of Gammu in 832 AS. Signals identical to those originating from Gammu and the Technocrats were detected on the planet's surface. These signals immediately piqued the interest of Corsair and Core scouts. However, it soon became apparent that they represented only a limited planetary presence—presumably the result of the landing of a few survivors after the Battle of Gammu. This presence posed neither a tactical nor a strategic threat great enough for either the Corsairs or the Core, to warrant redistributing resources and personnel from different, much more urgent operations.</TEXT><POP/></RDL>

The weapon contains a cryogenics package that condenses and supercools hydrogen around a fullerened antimatter payload into a supercooled "slug" of antimatter-doped hydrogen ice. The projectile is then sent down a barrel containing a number of graviton-generating toroids, which, at the cost of a significant amount of power, attract and repel it in sequence like a gauss gun, imparting a minimum of heat on the outer layers of hydrogen ice while accelerating it to an effective velocity.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>The unquestionable superiority of the Mortar in capital warfare for long-range engagements compared to the relatively close-quarters plasma projectors used in Cerberus-type turrets, combined with the efficiency of a primarily energy-based weapon in a battle of attrition in contrast to conventional torpedoes, resulted in variants of the weapon being developed for cruisers and later battlecruisers, as well as a higher-input, higher-output version commonly known as the "Heavy Mortar". Regardless of the variant, the success of the Mortar ensured that the family of weapons would be seen on just about every warship in Sirius for centuries to come.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

500242
NAME
Heavy Mortar

500243
INFOCARD
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TRA data="1" mask="1" def="-2"/><JUST loc="center"/><TEXT> TL-45 "Heavy Mortar" Cryogenic Antimatter Projector </TEXT><PARA/><TRA data="0" mask="1" def="-1"/><JUST loc="left"/><TEXT></TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>The TL-45 "Heavy Mortar" owes its existence to the ever-present line of thinking that bigger is always better. After scaling the TL-25 "Mortar" down to fit comfortably on cruiser-class warships, ship designers realized that this left energy to be used at the higher end, with even the smallest of battleship armament capacitors losing only a quarter of their charge to a Mortar firing sequence. Thus was born the Heavy Mortar, a piece of overcharged artillery that uses twice the power and delivers twice the punch of a standard Mortar.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Where the Heavy Mortar's advantage is in delivering spikes of damage to a battleship's target, the older, smaller Mortar projectors still have their own uses. The increased strain of launching a much heavier, much more volatile projectile encased in four times the hydrogen ice of a standard Mortar slug requires extra time to cool down the weapon's cryogenics package and graviton tori between firings. While some fleet doctrines prefer the standard Mortar for its relative rapidity, others choose the Heavy Mortar on the grounds that if you can rip an enemy ship apart in a single volley, you don't need to worry about when you can fire the next.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

500343
NAME
[813 AS] Tensions Rising between Kusari and Bretonia

500344
NAME
[[ NEWS ARCHIVE - 813 AS ]]\n\nNEW TOKYO -- In a press release today Kusari officials have condemned Bretonia once again for the scale of the Bretonian Armed Forces build up in the Tau systems, after new information has emerged showing Bretonian warships stationed near Holman Outpost, a peaceful IMG installation in the Tau-31 system. Bretonian patrols were spotted as far as Tau-29, prompting fears of possible Bretonian annexation on the Kusari public. IMG officials have expressed regret over this course of action and continued to press for a peaceful resolution, despite already being pressed by obvious Bretonian colonialism. In response, Queen Carina I of Bretonia has officially attempted to explain these actions by pointing the blame at the honourable Kusari Naval Forces who have stalled for as long as they could in the face of a Bretonian military advance. She further continued spreading lies about Kusari material support for Bretonian eco-terrorists.\n\nIn response, the Kusari government has officially put out an order to rally the Naval Forces in preparation for a possible Bretonian attack. The Tau-29 system is shortly expected to be declared as part of a Kusari protectorate to ensure the system's continued independence from Bretonian military ambitions. The protectorate will also encompass the lawless Tau-23 system in order to assure the safety of Kusari territory.

500345
NAME
[812 AS] Tensions Rising between Bretonia and Kusari

500346
NAME
[[ NEWS ARCHIVE - 812 AS ]]\n\nNEW LONDON -- Peace in Sirius sector is under threat once again. The militaristic Kusari government supported by Hogosha criminals is doing everything to destabilize the situation in Tau space. Previously the only enemies that Bretonia had to deal with in the Tau systems were the Outcasts and the Gaians. Now however it appears that there is a new, more dangerous enemy - the Kusari Naval Forces. If that wasn't enough, the Queen's government has recently recovered proof that the Gaian eco-terrorist movement is being supplied directly from Kusari.\n\nIn response, New London launched an attempt to negotiate on the fragile Tau situation with Liberty as a mediater, an attempt which was repulsed by the Foreign Ministry of Kusari. This immediately launched concerns that the Kusari government is trying to provoke a full-scale war with Bretonia. The Queen's government refused to officially acknowledge this until proof had been produced of a Kusari military buildup in Tau-29, when hundreds of Kusari destroyers and gunboats have been spotted entering neutral Tau space.\n\nTo secure Bretonian borders, the Bretonian government ordered an increase in Armed Forces presence in the Tau-31 system. Armed Forces will concentrate on securing Bretonian holdings in the system, but will remain clear of the other Jump Gates within Tau-31. A Bretonian official commented on the situation: "We hope dearly that Kusari does not try to push this diplomatic failure into a war, for it will cost many lives. Bretonia will not bow to this sabre rattling and our forces will remain on orders to hold fire unless the Kusari Navy openly strikes us first".

500347
NAME
[812 AS] Coalition Formed Against Corsair Expansion

500348
NAME
[[ NEWS ARCHIVE - 812 AS ]]\n\nBUFFALO -- Since early 812 AS tensions have been steadily rising between the houses of Bretonia and Kusari, and it is expected open war will break out soon. What was less than expected however was news of Corsair involvement. A few weeks ago the Corsair plot was uncovered by Outcast operatives: the Corsairs and their Hogosha allies are attempting to use their influence on Samura to steer the Kusari government into open war with Bretonia! While the reasons for such a move are unknown as of yet, many speculations have emerged, including a possible renewed Corsair offensive on Cambridge while the Bretonian Armed Forces are busy elsewhere, and perhaps even a renewed strike on Outcast holdings in the Omicron systems in an attempt to tip the scales in the long war.\n\nWord has also came in of many factions now supporting the Corsairs in their move, including the Gaians in Bretonia and the Farmers Alliance movement in Kusari. This has immediately prompted a call for a summit on the issue, and today marks a breakthrough in the proceeding talks as a majority of Liberty Rogue, Lane Hacker and Molly leaders officially came together on Buffalo base to sign an alliance with the Outcast nation. The Junkers have also expressed their support, and in Kusari the Blood Dragons and Golden Chrysanthemums have invited Outcast representatives to discuss long term plans. Outcast leaders have stated that they hope this to successfully tip the scales in their favour and nip the Corsair threat in the bud.

500349
NAME
[812 AS] Tensions Rising between Bretonia and Kusari

500350
NAME
[[ NEWS ARCHIVE - 812 AS ]]\n\nMANHATTAN -- Crucial diplomatic talks between Bretonia and Kusari broke down today over the issue of implied Kusari funding of the notorious Gaian eco-terrorist movement, which operates in Bretonia and is responsible for over a hundred confirmed hits on Orbital Spa and Cruise staff, including Libertonian citizens. Although neither side has as of yet officially declared war on the other, fighting is said to have already broken out in the disputed Tau-31 system. It is at this time unknown which side initiated the hostilities, but word from both houses implies a heavy military build up on the move into the Tau systems followed by a lock down of traffic between the two houses. The Libertonian government remained committed to peace, calling for a restart of talks - a motion promptly denied by Kusari officials citing Bretonia's "obvious colonialist intentions". Upon being accused by a unaligned news agency of initiating the military build up in Tau-29, Kusari officials refused to comment.\n\nIn other news, reports of an increase in pirate attacks on the fringes of house space have Libertonian analysts working over time. A connection seems to be implied between the rapidly increasing Kusari aggressiveness, an influx of artifact trade coming in unchecked from Shikoku and these pirates. Libertonian government officials reported they will be looking into the matter.

This mod's purpose is to expand the Freelancer universe without spoiling its original atmosphere. We have not changed every aspect of Freelancer that could possibly be changed, as it is not our intention to create a total conversion mod. Even though a list of new Discovery features is huge - and growing with each new release - all modifications are integrated into the familiar Freelancer world.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>The year is 820 After Settlement (AS), 19 years after the single-player campaign of Freelancer, and two years after the events of Discovery 4.86. The Sirius sector is still embroiled in one major war, while other smaller conflicts are approaching critical instability in other areas. Bretonia has been forced to retreat from the GRN onslaught, and Leeds is now under the total control of Gallia. The GRN's seemingly unstoppable advance has overflowed into other systems, and even now their scouts encroach upon the Independent Worlds that connect Bretonia to Liberty. However, in response to Gallia's increasing threat, Liberty is diverting some of its own naval squadrons to the region in order to slow the hostile advance and protect the key shipping lines between the two Houses. This is only becoming possible due to drastic action by Rheinland, in which they severed the Jump Gates to the Hamburg system in order to halt further Libertonian attacks. While these two Houses are still technically at war, the scale of the conflict has been greatly reduced.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>However, despite facing less aggression from Liberty, the choice to focus its attention on that war front in previous years has had dire consequences behind the lines. The Red Hessian movement has run rampant over the Dresden system, claiming most of it for themselves. Meanwhile, a mysterious disaster in the Munich system is causing thousands to flee the settlements there, and investigations are still continuing.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Having been defeated by Gallia in the field of battle, the newly-reformed Republican government of Kusari has opened its borders for economic exchange. Their intention is to reinforce their not insignificant infrastructure with new technologies introduced by Gallic Corporations. However, all may not go to plan, as there is increasing civilian unrest driven by supporters of the exiled Imperial family who would see them returned to the throne. Soon the Kusari Exile fleet will be returning home, and it will not be quiet.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Discovery version 4.87 is focussed on improving and updating much of the content added in previous version, with greater diversity of equipment available for different ship classes. Many new commodities throughout Sirius offer exciting opportunities for profit through various lawful and unlawful trade routes. NPCs are now fewer, but more challenging to defeat. There are many more changes, additions and enhancements introduced in Discovery, see the Readme.txt for a full list. The modification is tested to make each release as bug-free as possible, but should you encounter any issues, please contact us on the official forums to help resolve them.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Discovery is playable both in multiplayer and single-player game modes. The original SP has been disabled as it is no longer compatible with the mod, and thus "Open SP" is enabled. In multiplayer, you may play on Discovery RP 24/7 official server, as well as on many other servers running Discovery mod.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>If you are playing on one of the official servers, don't forget to visit http://www.discoverygc.com for additional information and server rules. It is strongly recommended that you read the server rules before playing. Our community is welcoming to newcomers, and you can receive help for whatever problems you may encounter. Please take note of any messages being displayed while you are playing: they contain some of the important information you should know. There is also an item containing the core principles of our rules in your character's cargo hold that you receive when your character was first created.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>We hope you will enjoy every moment playing Discovery. Good luck out there!</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Please see the Readme.txt for a list of mod Developers and other contributors. Thanks to everyone who helped to make this achievement possible!</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TRA data="1" mask="1" def="-2"/><JUST loc="center"/><TEXT>Properties</TEXT><PARA/><TRA data="0" mask="1" def="-1"/><PARA/><JUST loc="left"/><TEXT>Base Price: $1</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>Container Hitpoints: 250</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>Cargo Space Per Unit: 1</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

500710
NAME
[804 AS] Zoners Fail Corsair Expectations

500711
NAME
FREEPORT 9 -- 804 AS -- Negotiations between the Corsairs and the Zoners to build a Corsair installation in Omicron Theta have failed. Zoner representatives would not agree to allow a Corsair battleship fleet into their system, despite the fleet being necessary to protect the building site. The Zoners claimed that the presence of a Corsair fleet would threaten the peace in the whole sector. Further conflicts between the Zoners and the Corsairs such as this are expected, as the Corsair expansion is more and more dependent on continuing Zoner shipments. However, both the Corsairs and the Zoners have profited greatly from the recent decades of cooperation and expansion in the Omicron worlds, and are therefore unlikely to start a costly war with an unknown outcome and doubtful consequences.

500715
NAME
[813 AS] Liberty Trying to Prevent War

500716
NAME
MANHATTAN -- 813 AS -- President Jacobi has today proposed a meeting of representatives from all the colonies in an attempt to resolve the rapidly escalating tensions in Tau-31. Should the call be answered, the meeting would take place on Planet Los Angeles in the California system, far away from the encroaching war. Queen Carina's office has already confirmed Bretonia's attendance, but it is still yet unclear whether Kusari will agree to participate, after the Kusari government accused their Bretonian counterparts of assisting various pirate and terrorist groups in Kusari proper a few days ago. Rheinland officials have also declared their doubt, but promised attendance of one of their representatives.\n\nDespite Jacobi's call for peace, it is unlikely the fighting in Tau space will cease, as both Bretonia and Kusari continue to mobilise for the conflict. Reports confirm a Bretonian pre-emptive strike is under way into Tau-29, while Kusari is expected to slowly pull forces from their main systems in order to reinforce their defense. The reason, Naval Forces spokesmen have said, is a string of heavy handed pirate attacks on Kusari holdings in Honshu which required strong intervention: "Intervening forces are expected to shortly make their way to the Tau-29 front where they will push the battle in their favour". When asked about the feasibility and impact of such a move on the Kusari core, Liberty Navy officials declined to comment.

500717
NAME
[813 AS] Rheinland Responding to Tau Events

500718
NAME
NEW BERLIN -- 813 AS -- The Rheinland Foreign Office has issued a press release regarding recent Tau events today stating Rheinland's official stance on the matter: "Bretonia and Kusari seem to be locked into pursuing this senseless conflict, and although their leaders seem headstrong to participate in the coming bloodshed, the rest of Sirius should not". After making it clear the blame for the hostilities lies on the Bretonian house for pushing the situation to the breaking point, the Office continued by expressing their support for the IMG plight: "Rheinland remembers the horrors of war better than anybody else, and it is always the civilians that end up on the firing line. The colonies should do everything in their power to ensure IMG miners are safe in the struggle". The speaker has also stated a Rheinland representative will attend the Los Angeles summit called by President Jacobi for promoting peace between the colonies. Among rumours of Bretonian intent to threaten IMG holdings in the Bretonian core worlds in order to assure their cooperation, Rheinland is expected to further condemn continued Bretonian operations against Kusari in the Tau systems.

500719
NAME
[814 AS] Anti-Corsair Coalition Broadens

500720
NAME
MALTA -- 814 AS -- The Bretonia-Kusari conflict continues to escalate in Tau-29 and Tau-31, and the Corsairs are expected to also make a move soon. The Outcasts are preparing their defenses as Corsairs continue to try and ensure a lack of Zoner involvement in any military operations that would take place in Omicron Theta. Despite the obvious Corsair threat, the Zoners of Freeport 9 continue stalling between proposals for cooperation from both the Outcasts and the Corsairs.\n\nDespite this surprising lack of direct military activity, the Outcasts have succeeded in rallying many core world factions to their cause.  These include Mollys from Bretonia; Liberty Rogues and Lane Hackers from Liberty; Blood Dragons and Golden Chrysanthemums from Kusari; and lately and most importantly the Red Hessians and Bundschuh from Rheinland. In contrast the Gaians of Bretonia, Hogosha and Farmers Alliance from Kusari, and Unioners from Rheinland, as well as in an extremely surprising move, The Order chose to side with the Corsairs. Both sides continue to try to rally support from the other factions of Sirius, however no other group has openly declared support for the Outcasts or the Corsairs so far.

500721
NAME
[813 AS] Bretonia on the Brink of War

500722
NAME
NEW LONDON -- 813 AS -- The Bretonian government today delivered a bleak and extremely controversial speech after reports of open conflict between Bretonian and Kusari forces appeared in the news earlier this week. "All attempts to secure a peaceful solution have failed. The Kusari media is already blaming us for the first shots. We have no choice but to respond, or let Planet Harris fall into Kusari hands". The Home Office has followed by quickly declaring war time measures in place, and further Bretonian forces are expected to embark for the Tau-29 front within a matter of days. First news from the front suggest Bretonia is making progress against the Kusari defenses with Kusari casualties several times higher than Bretonian ones to date. Further Armed Forces reinforcements are expected to shift the balance squarely in Bretonia's favour.\n\nIn the mean time in Bretonia itself the IMG is unpatriotically accusing the Queen's government of coercion by threat of blockade. The IMG representative claims this was done "in order to assure the IMG cooperates with Bretonia's plan of claiming the majority of independent Tau space". The Bretonian government swiftly denied these accusations, and responded by saying that these rumours are the product of Kusari media "seeking to justify their parent government's attack on Bretonian holdings". The matter is expected to be resolved in the Bretonian Royal Court.

500723
NAME
[814 AS] Kusari Close to Victory in Tau-31

500724
NAME
NEW TOKYO -- 814 AS -- Bretonian attempts to delay Kusari fleet movements by employing pirates known as the Golden Chrysanthemums within the Kusari core worlds has failed, as a Naval Forces mobilisation has reduced pirate presence in Kyushu to an all time low. The Chrysanthemums are a fanatical female movement which attempts to overthrow the Kusari government in order to replace it with a liberal, cardamine fueled matriarchy. The Bretonian government was further implicated after State Police forces seized a transport smuggling explosives to Hokkaido, on board which was a message intended to Chrysanthemum terrorists, signed by a high ranking Bretonian official. These efforts, as underhanded and sneaky as they might be, have hardly impeded progress however with no less than six Kusari battleship class vessels expected to reinforce the front line in Tau-29 within the next three days.\n\nWith Bretonian attacks rapidly diminishing, the final liberation of Tau-31 appears to draw close. Although the Naval Forces has stood its ground and maintained low losses, a spirit of vengeance befalls our people. Bretonia must be purged from the Tau border worlds, there is no other way.

500725
NAME
[814 AS] An Unlikely Ally

500726
NAME
CRETE -- 814 AS -- The Bretonians always take their time to make a point about Corsair "pirates maiming their peaceful men, women and children". In the mean time they not only launch the first strike against another colony, but they also shoot at IMG civilians to pacify them, ally with and and take supplies from Outcast drug dealers for their cut of the spoils, and shove the blame squarely in other people's laps so that their war can extend as far outward as possible. How can the colonies listen to their lies, in the wake of all that has happened lately? The Bretonian government grows rich on gold and high on cardamine, and it is only a matter of time before their madness is noticed and disposed of.\n\nThere is only one thing we can do now: support the Kusari navy in their advance. Allow them to smash the Bretonian war machine, and secure the Tau systems from the vile Outcast cardamine trade. Any true Corsair will see that this is the right thing to do. Do this, and soon we will rise toasts to the smoldering ruins of Cali Base deep in the Tau systems -- and soon after, the burning cardamine fields of Malta.

500841
NAME

Needless to say that losing this base will be a fatal blow for Cardamine business of the Outcasts.
