500916
NAME
[814 AS] Tau-31 Lost, Harris under Siege

500917
NAME
NEW LONDON -- 814 AS -- A Kusari push has disabled a significant portion of Bretonian defenses in Tau-31 yesterday, after a surprise attack from a previously unknown jump hole allowed the enemy to perform a two pronged strike. Armed Forces admirals were forced to call a general retreat into the Leeds system, with only a handful of troops and one battleship remaining stranded behind enemy lines, locked in a desperate defense of Planet Harris made possible only through extensive use of mines and other fortifications hidden within the ice asteroid field. Kusari forces were reported to seize on their momentum in a careful fashion, allowing only scouting units to jump through to Leeds as the Armed Forces organised their second line around Glasgow.\n\nInstead, an effort to completely blockade Planet Harris was organised after a failed attack on the lone Bretonian Battleship left in the system left Naval Forces with several cruisers either destroyed or disabled, and many fighter wings lost to the ever present mines and dogged Armed Forces defenders. Although the situation appears grim, a spokesman from the Armed Forces has insisted that a counter strike plan is already being prepared and that the current state of affairs in Tau-31 is only temporary.

500918
NAME
[814 AS] Situation in Tau-31 Critical

500919
NAME
MALTA -- 814 AS -- The situation in Tau space becomes worse by the day as the Bretonians crumble under the force of the Kusari Naval Forces. In but a month Kusari has managed to occupy the Tau-31 system and create a massive obstacle on the path of our Cardamine transports to Liberty. Cali Base is being rallied in case of a surprise attack. At the very least the ever annoying IMG miners that infest the Tau systems continue to refuse to pick a side in the conflict, though it is quite obvious that by doing nothing they benefit Kusari more than Bretonia. The biggest threat the Outcasts face however is one of a two pronged strike. If the Corsairs and their new Kusari lap dogs decide to attempt an attack on Malta, the Outcast fleet will be hard pressed to fight on two fronts.\n\nTo prevent this, resources will be poured to the Red Hessians in the Omega systems, so that the Corsair forces are occupied and off balance. A generous twist of fate has also made the Unioners reconsider their previous allegiances and join their Hessian allies against the Corsairs once again. Other allies need to continue to fight against the Corsair allies in any way they can, such as the Mollys who provided the Armed Forces with enough stationary mines to cover the entire approach to Harris in Tau-31 and delay the Kusari navy seemingly indefinitely. The Maltan way must prevail.

500920
NAME
[814 AS] Disgrace of Bretonia in Tau-31

500921
NAME
CRETE -- 814 AS -- Kusari Naval Forces waste no time in liberating Tau-31 from the blight of Bretonia. Meanwhile, Outcasts carry on trying to rally their servants to help the failing Bretonians hold on to their last scrap in the system: Planet Harris. And yet even then the Armed Forces continues to lose every protracted engagement. Not even the Mollys with their endless supply of mines and other cowardly tactics will be able to hold off the Naval Forces advance for long. Soon enough the Kusari will enjoy a drink on Leeds, and the Corsairs will have one on Cambridge. Without their Cardamine highway, the Outcasts will fall into ruin and it is then that the Corsair Empire will be able to strike at Malta itself.

500922
NAME
[814 AS] Bretonian Cowards Trap Kusari Fleet

500923
NAME
NEW TOKYO -- 814 AS -- In a shameful move that disgraced Bretonia and Queen Carina, Bretonia Armed Forces have set a trap for the assaulting Kusari fleet. With the help of Molly terrorists, mine fields were set up around Planet Harris, a terraforming site of Planetform. Outcasts helped to conceal the mines from our scouts. 7 cruisers and 6 gunboats and numerous fighters were trapped in those mine fields and destroyed, either by mines or by Bretonia patrols. More than 800 women and men of Kusari died this day, but their death will quickly be avenged.\n\nThe battle near Harris in 813 AS will be known as our only defeat in the war with Bretonia. Bretonia Armed Forces cannot win in an open fight, as was proved in the recent battle for the Leeds Jump Gate. Losing most of their fleet, including one battleship, Bretonia forces fled to Leeds and to Harris. The Kusari Naval Forces surrounded Harris and mapped the mine fields to avoid further casualties. We will proceed with care, expecting more dishonest moves from the cowards of Bretonia.

500924
NAME
[814 AS] Bretonia is Losing the War

500925
NAME
MANHATTAN -- 814 AS -- After several months of unabated fighting, Bretonia is buckling under the unrelenting assault of the Kusari Naval Forces in the Tau-31 system. Despite the exceptional bravery of Armed Forces pilots in fighting back the Kusari aggressors, they are forced into continuous fighting retreat as almost the entire might of the Kusari navy is pouring forth from Kyushu and New Tokyo into the Tau systems. Bretonia, having issues securing Cambridge from unrelenting pirate attacks as it stands, is unable to gather enough forces to effectively stand ground, and are forced to retreat to their many fortifications -- such as the ones set up around Planet Harris, which immediately sparked condemnation from the Kusari government after an assault on the Planet was successfully repulsed before ever reaching the surface due to the valiant Armed Forces defenders present there.\n\nThe front line, however, is not the only place for casualties of war. Many Bretonian citizens, tourists and businessmen present in Kusari at the time of the official declaration of war were arrested and placed in camps for foreign nationals. They remain under hold by the Kusari government whose officials are still declining any offers of prisoner and civilian exchanges. Officials in Liberty have widely condemned these actions, and pressure continues on Interspace Commerce to begin financial sanctions on the house of Kusari until prisoners of war and Bretonian civilians are allowed to be expatriated back to their home colony. Officials have also stated that, "despite the advanced stage of the war, it is never too late to seek a peaceful resolution". The Bretonian-Kusari war however looks set to continue for many years more, with Kusari forces expecting to push into Leeds in a matter of months.

500926
NAME
[814 AS] Bretonia In Violation Of War Charter

500927
NAME
NEW BERLIN -- 814 AS -- The Rheinland Reichstag today almost uniformly decried the Bretonian use of concealed mines in the defense of Planet Harris, after Kusari officials suggested mine use will leave the area heavily dangerous for years to come, regardless of when the conflict will end. The public outcry was followed by an implication that Bretonia may in fact be in violation of the War Charter established in the colonies after the events of the 80 Years War, which specifically forbids the use of passive weapons which may render an area extremely dangerous to civilians after the conflict has passed. The discussion concluded with a motion for a new demand for Bretonia to withdraw all forces from Tau-31 and cede claims of the system to Kusari, so that proper demilitarisation can occur. The Rheinland Foreign Office has refused to comment on the Reichstag's proclamations, implying that the views held by the representatives are their own, and may not be in line with those held by the Chancellor of Rheinland.

500928
NAME
Kusari Elite Fighter

Salvation came with the accidental discovery of a planetoid hidden within the Stone Veil cloud.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>This planetoid, dubbed Tritonis many years after its discovery, was the site of a gargantuan ancient ruin of unknown origin. Intrigued by the groundbreaking discovery, the Kingdom of Gallia dispatched Royal Intelligence assets to secure the area and establish a research base. The massive complex was hewn into the rock of the structure to better access the ruins and use the planetoid itself as a shield from heavy radiation. Though initial hopes believed there would be findings enough to revolutionize Gallic understanding of the universe, they were aborted by the imminent collapse of the jump hole that led them to this strange place.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Without regular supply convoys, the expedition struggled to survive over the coming weeks, with members dying to attrition with every passing day. In a desperate, last ditch effort, the remaining survivors attempted to regroup and make for the sole potentially habitable moon in the system. Failing that, they would bank on a sublight burn out of the Labyrinth to get some kind of signal out to the unknowing Kingdom they called home. None of these efforts bore fruit, and the explorers never returned home.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Over the course of history, classified knowledge regarding Tritonis and Tau-61 became the stuff of urban legend and conspiracy theory amid the conflicts between the Crown and Council dissidents. Conspiracy passed into legend as spacers yet spoke of a fabled, forgotten ruin in the clouds, hidden behind an ever-shifting doorway to a graveyard of a system. Some were even said to have found the mythical place, yet none ever returned. With the exodus of Vagrants carving a terrifying trail of destruction through the Orkney system, these legends have been resurrected. They say that all spacers' tales hold a grain of truth to them, after all.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

501505
NAME
[815 AS] War in Tau Space Continues

501506
NAME
MANHATTAN -- 815 AS -- Fall of 814 AS will be remembered as the first time the nations of Sirius saw a hope for peace between Kusari and Bretonia in the War for Tau-31, when in a surprising move Kusari offered a six month truce to Bretonia, which was quickly accepted by the Queen's government. Analysts were quick to point out that the attrition of Bretonian fortifications at Harris and the skilled use of the Leeds Jump Gate choke point continued to put great pressure on the Kusari Naval Forces which now needed time to consolidate and protect their gains from frequent and frenzied pirate attacks. At the same time Bretonia lacked the strength to accomplish a breakthrough against Kusari lines. The ensuing stalemate and the following truce proposal seemed like an excellent opportunity for lasting peace negotiations.\n\nIt was thus all the more shameful that the peace process broke down so quickly. Only two months into the truce, at the beginning of 815 AS both sides began gathering forces at each side of the Leeds gate in an attempt to dissuade one another from any surprise attacks. Within two more months fighting broke out once again after Bretonian forces broke the truce by engaging Kusari forces in Tau-31 through a surprise attack using the jump hole from the Dundee system followed by the main strike from Leeds. However, despite Bretonian initial gains the Kusari Navy held the fort. Bretonian forces suffered heavy casualties during the Leeds break out, a loss they would be hard pressed to recover from.\n\nThe fleet striking from Dundee had more success, having taken the Kusari forces at Holman Outpost completely by surprise and inflicting heavy casualties. It was not until reinforcements from Tau-29 arrived, that Kusari has repulsed the attack and forced the Armed Forces in Tau-31 to retreat to Harris once again. During the battle itself Holman Outpost was heavily damaged by Kusari battery fire. Several independent miners were killed; an act that prompted an apology from the Kusari government, but did nothing to demilitarise the area around the station. Kusari Naval Forces continued to use Holman as a staging area, despite IMG requests to the contrary.\n\nWith the truce broken and any hope of a quick peace in shambles, the war for Tau-31 rages on. Kusari continues pressing its goal of complete Bretonian elimination in the Tau systems, while the dogged defenders of Harris continue to stand in the face of a naval blockade. Time will only tell how this conflict will finally end.

501507
NAME
[815 AS] Bretonia Breaks Truce

501508
NAME
NEW BERLIN -- 815 AS -- The war for Tau-31 continues. The six month truce offered to Bretonia by Kusari was broken this week by the Bretonian Armed Forces, after the latter launched a surprise attack on the Kusari staging area at Holman Outpost in an attempt to cripple the Kusari defenders. A previously unknown jump hole was purported to have been used in the breakout attempt, though the attackers were in the end unable to hold the offensive, and were forced to pull back to Planet Harris before further Kusari reinforcements reached the system, thus effectively lengthening the war by many months. Twenty eight independent miners have also been reported to have died due to collateral damage as a result of the attack. The Kusari government delivered a quick apology for the incident, but continued pressing the need for a militarisation of the space around Holman in the face of unexpected Bretonian attacks on the area.A spokesman from the Rheinland government said: "We share the concerns of the IMG regarding such a move, I think it is safe to say we can expect only an escalation of violence in Tau-31 as a result of this Bretonian attack".

501509
NAME
[819 AS] Outcasts Safe in Tau-23

501510
NAME
CALI -- 819 AS -- The invasion of the Gallic naval fleets into Orkney and Tau-23 were cause for uncertainty among many Outcasts. But since then, we have learned much about their capabilities and intentions. The Gallic forces are bound for Bretonia, and in their wake follow many supply shipments, which provide an opportunity to seize materials much closer to Malta then ever before. The Gallic forces seem unaccustomed to fighting within the dense asteroid fields of the Taus, but it is second nature to our own fighters. They are however better equipped than the miner vagrants that call themselves the IMG.\n\nIt is in our best interests to inflict as much damage on the Gallic forces as possible. Should Bretonia fall, Gallia may decide to attack towards Genoa instead, and that would eventually put Malta itself at risk.

501511
NAME
[815 AS] War Without End

501512
NAME
NEW LONDON -- 815 AS -- In a recent address to the nation, Queen Carina has called for the Bretonian people to "stand firm, patient and courageous in the face of Kusari aggression" after the treaty that was supposed to last six months at the minimum was broken after only four. Bretonian Armed Forces officials cite the reason for renewed hostilities as "the need to respond to the Kusari naval build up preparing to strike on Leeds", with government officials rallying to the opinion that Kusari government was planning to break the truce regardless so that they can push their advantage into sovereign Bretonian territory.\n\nThe truce was broken after Bretonian forces moved through a previously unknwon system into Tau-31, bypassing Kusari defenses at the Leeds gate and seizing Holman for a couple of hours before Kusari reinforcements arrived at the scene. Despite the attack not making any significant gains, the Bretonian Armed Forces reports that the strike allowed them to reinforce both Planet Harris and BMM holdings in Tau-23, further strengthening the defensive lines. The war is expected to continue in full capacity for months to come.

501513
NAME
[815 AS] Bretonia Attempts to Strike Back

501514
NAME
CRETE -- 815 AS -- Yet another treacherous strike marks Bretonia's history today, as the Armed Forces moved into Tau-31 in an attempt to catch the Kusari navy unprepared, and broke the cease fire that was supposed to last for months more. Kusari forces have rallied fast and repulsed the attack, but the damage was already done: more Bretonians now reinforce Planet Harris, which will make the war even more drawn out than it already is. A quick resolution is now all but a myth.\n\nThe attacking Bretonians revealed one of the jump holes they have been using to communicate with Tau-31 through this however: the so called Dundee jump hole was used to transport a large attack force behind Kusari lines, and after that attack was routed the Kusari fleet quickly moved through it to engage the remaining Bretonian forces there and seize the choke point. Should they manage to win in the system, Edinburgh should be up for easy grabs.

501515
NAME
[815 AS] Bretonia Breaks the Truce

501516
NAME
NEW TOKYO -- 815 AS -- The Bretonian government has once again proved their incompetence and treachery by breaking the peace treaty and attacking Kusari Naval Forces in Tau-31 just two days ago. The treaty having been proposed by the honourable Kusari government was made last year in the name of promoting an end to the vile conflict in Tau-31, and was supposed to last for six months - yet was broken after only four. The Kusari government has been swift to respond by making it explicitly clear that peace is out of the question in the face of the constant militaristic threat that Kusari is facing, and that the Bretonian government must be unseated for any peace process to be able to occur. A Naval Forces spokesman mentioned Kusari forces having found a "new way into Bretonia, one that will allow [Kusari forces] to fight on an even more equal footing". He further added that the war is expected to progress into core Bretonian systems within a matter of months.

501517
NAME
[815 AS] The Legacy of the Nomad War

501518
NAME
NEW BERLIN -- 815 AS -- Although the war instigated by the traitor Niemann has been over for almost 14 years now, echoes of the conflict continue to shake Rheinland society as it struggles to rebuild its former power after the abject defeats during the many battles of 801 AS What remains a mystery however is the unexplained disappearance of the survivors of the battlegroup that attacked Honshu. Accounts from the conflict itself seem to confirm that the Military fleet made great initial gains against the Kusari navy but was eventually pushed back and forced to retreat to Sigma-13, where the surviving forces seemed to simply disappear into the gas clouds.\n\nStatistics show no less than hundreds of ships going missing in the aftermath of the War of 800 AS that were never accounted for since. This mystery kept on baffling historians and analysts: could it be possible that the battlegroup's officers were more loyal to Niemann than to their Fatherland? A connection was made when a rising spate of pirate strikes on the edges of Rheinland space turned out to actually be terrorist attacks by what seemed to have been Rheinland pilots flying older generation Military ships. In the wake of such attacks the inevitable question was raised: could Niemann and his cronies have returned to plague Rheinland once more?\n\nThese attackers have quickly earned the nickname "Die Wilden" or the "Wild" by the survivors of their attacks, owing to a supposed feral attitude and lack of mercy for military personnel and civilians alike. In response the Rheinland Military was officially briefed on action against such traitorous attacks, such that it continued to steadily protect the nation and themselves. Nonetheless, little is known about the group or their ultimate goals. All that is taken for granted is the fact that these so called "Wild" shoot to kill, take no prisoners and are extremely dangerous, and that any who encounter them would do well to attempt escape toward the nearest Military strong point immediately.

501848
NAME
[816 AS] War in Tau-31 and Dundee Set For Stalemate

501849
NAME
NEW TOKYO -- 816 AS -- The war over Tau-31 continues to rage on, meanwhile Naval Forces commanders have abandoned their plans for immediate offensive into Leeds over allegations that the government is sending too many forces abroad, leaving the homeland exposed to pirate attacks. The admiralty has instead opted for a tactic of entrenchment in Tau-31, devoting present standing forces to crack down on smugglers running the blockade to Harris and Tau-23 within the system for as long as further reinforcements from Kusari are delayed. When asked whether it is a wise move to give the Bretonians ample time to prepare, a spokesman for the Naval Forces responded: "the Bretonians have nothing and they know it. The only thing they can do is delay the inevitable".\n\nKyushu, Tau-29 and Tau-23 have reported a record number of pirate attacks in the last quarter, with a great likelyhood of these attacks being funded by the Bretonian crown. These new measures by the Kusari navy are expected to help stamp this presence down once again.

501850
NAME
[816 AS] A New Threat in the Omega Sector

501851
NAME
CADIZ -- 816 AS -- The Bretonian-Kusari war is set to last far longer than the Corsair Elders initially expected. The initial expectations of a swift, surprise conquest of Tau-23 that would cripple the Outcasts at the start fell terribly short, and gave the opposing factions time to rally together to oppose the Corsair plan by putting their mutual issues aside and uniting against them. That not being the end of it, a new enemy using unknown, exotic and extremely dangerous brands of weapons appeared suddenly within core Omega space, dealing noticable losses to both the Red Hessians and standing Corsair forces, making it look as if the fates had conspired against the Corsairs in every way possible.\n\nThus, the order to consolidate has been given. The conquest of the Outcast homeworld is no longer considered as the main objective. The Outcasts have heavily fortified the Omicron Eta system, to the extent that head on assault is no longer feasible. With Rheinland openly criticising Liberty and vice versa, any future conflict between the two may lead to the Red Hessians relocating more of their forces to the Omega systems, and forming a critical mass that may even threaten Cadiz and Leon bases. Whatever happens, the Corsairs will be prepared. The Elders are ready to wait for their time to strike one of the many Corsair enemies, and at least a few of them will be weakened enough soon so that they can be finished off.

501852
NAME
[816 AS] Bretonia Keeps Borders Safe

501853
NAME
NEW LONDON -- 816 AS -- Despite the hard push by Kusari naval units, the Bretonian Armed Forces has kept the border safe with not a single Kusari strike managing to break through the line so far. The Kusari assault on Dundee was broken and forced to retreat back into the Tau-31 system. The Leeds Jump Gate remains secure with a Bretonian build up keeping the space safe on the Leeds side, while the defenders of Harris continue staring down the besieging Kusari navy with neither side willing to advance into the mine fields separating them.\n\nThe war is set to descend into yet another lengthy stalemate, although some analysts are set in their claim that this situation is simply "the calm before the storm". Not content to just disregard such claims, the Armed Forces continue to fortify the borders hoping to be prepared for any kind of Kusari attack long before it happens.

501854
NAME
[816 AS] Sirius Wide War on the Horizon

501855
NAME
MALTA -- 816 AS -- The war between Bretonia and Kusari continues as expected. Neither house is ready to give up, with the Bretonians hoping the attrition on the Kusari forces will force them to give concessions, while the Kusari navy stays firm with its assurances of an ability to breach Bretonian defenses. Both are locked in a stalemate at the moment, although Kusari is expected to eventually breach the lines even if at great cost.\n\nIn the mean time past rivalries between Liberty and Rheinland suddenly begin to flare up once again with Rheinland's public accusations of unsanctioned Libertonian research taking place in a hidden system. The Rheinland Foreign Office officially blamed the newly elected President Powell for this research, claiming they have proof to back it up, yet have still so far refused to release any files pertaining to the situation. Furthermore, several rumours of a purported Nomad control over a great many Liberty Navy officers have been spreading across the neural net almost unchecked. One can only assume what the answer from Liberty will be at this point in time.

501856
NAME
[816 AS] Rheinland Media Blast Powell for "Unethical Research"

501857
NAME
MANHATTAN -- 816 AS -- Liberty officials have been rushing to rebuke claims by the Rheinland state media that the Liberty Navy is pursuing unsanctioned and extremely dangerous research on alien technology, despite similar activities already leading to one Sirius wide war not 15 years ago. When asked for his statement on the situation, President James Powell responded: "This is a wholly ridiculous claim. The Liberty Navy has never possessed alien technology or artifacts, nor has it done research on them. This is simply yet another attempt by Rheinland to bash this presidency for pushing for the remainder of the Stuttgart debt to be repaid sooner, and I for one will not stand idly by while they try to instigate a pointless witch hunt to discredit us".\n\nThe Liberty government has also officially responded by stating that claims of the Liberty Navy being infiltrated are unfounded, as the LSF has been heavily involved in screening every individual holding high positions within the Navy structure since the end of the Nomad War in order to prevent any future possibilities of an armed coup. Meanwhile, the Rheinland state media is set to publicly release a documentary on the subject within a matter of weeks, possibly further exacerbating the crisis.

501858
NAME
[816 AS] Stalemate in the Tau Sector

501859
NAME
NEW BERLIN -- 816 AS -- The Tau sector looks set to be embroiled by war for years to come, as both Bretonia and Kusari turn to stationary defenses with only minor direct engagements taking place while they consolidate their forces once again. The Kusari government however is set to once again achieve the upper hand if the decision to transfer further forces from the core Kusari systems is made. In the mean time, Bretonia revels in their small victory in Dundee where they repulsed an equal Kusari force back to the Tau-31 jump hole and successfully held it.\n\nNo matter the outcome of the war, it appears clear that the IMG will be the losers. Faced with either Kusari military occupation or Bretonian sanctions against Holman on charges of collaboration, the independent miners are faced with a difficult position of attempting to balance between two strong forces. Holman itself has become virtually abandoned as a result of the war, with only a skeleton crew remaining after the most recent incident where a misfired blast hit the station's hull and killed several crew members. If the war drags on for a few years more, the station is quite likely to be eventually left derelict.

501875
NAME
[816 AS] Liberty Into Research On Aliens?

501876
NAME
HAMBURG -- 816 AS -- It is a matter of public knowledge that the Liberty government is as opposed to alien artifact trading as any government in Sirius. But could the actual truth be different? An unnamed source in Liberty has provided a great amount of insight into the forbidden forays of the Liberty government: an effort to import alien artifacts and carry out forbidden research, wholly against the Charter of the Colonies.\n\nAccording to the information sent by the source this initiative was started by President James Powell, a strong supporter of Libertonian "military power", at the onset of his term. Since then Liberty has not only amassed a strong, militaristic buildup of Naval forces, but has also secretly imported thousands of supposedly defunct alien artifacts -- a fact that has been quite simply concealed from the public. Considering it is well known that the only documented source of such nomad technology is placed deep in the edge worlds in the form of a notorious pirate empire, it can therefore be concluded that Liberty has since established a relationship with these unlawful brigands, likely to the detriment of both Rheinland and Bretonia.\n\nThen there is the research on live specimens. According to our source, Liberty has allegedly procured a number of live alien hosts several years ago, using which its scientists successfully performed extensive research on the alien genome, going so far as breeding them in laboratory conditions and experimenting with human-alien hybrids! News of this have left Rheinland government officials in complete bewilderment: has Liberty already forgotten the folly of experimenting with alien technology, and the effect it had on the crazed Chancellor Niemann? Right now the possibility of President Powell already being under the influence of alien artifacts is considered by the Rheinland government as quite real, and the recent increase in Liberty patrols and checkpoints on the Liberty-Rheinland border has prompted a similar response from the Rheinland state. State officials have already responded they will be attempting to establish the legitimacy of the Liberty source before further action is taken.

501877
NAME
[819 AS] Omicron Eta Still Stalemated

501878
NAME
FREEPORT 9 -- 819 AS -- Since the Omicron Eta system was discovered for the first time, it was destined to become the "no man's land" between the Corsairs and the Outcasts. Providing quick access to both Omicron Alpha and Omicron Gamma, both sides were quick to fortify the system on their own respective ends, and fighting has continued inbetween ever since. In response to the constant attempts at deeper incursions, both sides began spreading stationary mines between the nebula and Planet Catania. Eventually the last Zoners from the inhabiting the system left, and the result was a battlefield split in two by a large field of stationary mines, deadly to any who would venture inside.\n\nBoth sides continue fighting over the system, though locked in a stalemate. The superior skill and abilities of Outcast pilots are evenly matched by the numbers the Corsairs employ in their pursuit of conquest. It is without doubt that to conflict in Omicron Eta will carry on for many years more before any conclusion is reached.

One such shortfall resulted in mass hunger in 710 AGS (794 AS) -- the enraged workers declared a general strike. Marne’s refineries fell silent. Marne’s citizens were initially elated, providing much of the manpower and industry that sustained The Council’s war effort. While many Outcast ships can land on Malta without any issues - ranging from transports to cruisers - the starports on the planet proved vulnerable, allowing rebellious slavers to destroy or, even worse, partially capture and utilize these valuable vessels against their former masters.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>The Malta Orbital Dock serves as a security and logistical intermediary between incoming ships and the planet's surface. INFOCARD
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>Schatten Research Facility was constructed in 797 AS, although little is known about its purpose or activities during that period. The station was destroyed during the Colony Wars; the wreckage subsequently lay abandoned for several years. The Rheinland Military salvaged several components in 803 AS, with the reactivated facility becoming instrumental as a forward staging point for the Purge of Thuringia. Schatten went on to serve as a classified research station concerned primarily with advancing the weapons and starship technologies of the Rheinland Military.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Operational control of the facility was transferred to the MND’s research division in 822 AS, following years of vicious inter-service political infighting on New Berlin. Due to this, it is unsurprising that Schatten refused to recognise the Military-backed Imperial coup during the Rheinland Civil War. Following the Battle of the Westerwald and the destruction of the Koblenz, Schatten became a rallying point for Federalist forces. For the duration of the conflict, research activities were suspended, with the station instead operating as a front-line Federalist repair yard.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>In the uncomfortable peace following the war, Schatten has once more returned to research activities under the MND's administration. In a compromise neither party is happy with, Military observers are now permanently stationed aboard to supervise and contribute to development projects.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

When Kusari invaded the system the following year, the Cassard was among the first vessels to rally a defense.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>The Cassard’s green crew were entirely outmatched when facing Kusari’s Battleships Hyono and Yamaguchi, escaping only through the efforts of allied Confederal Defense Forces. After receiving emergency repairs at Rambouillet Shipyard, it was dispatched to Burgundy to suppress Kusari privateers. With the rise of the Gallic Union and the end of the Kusari Invasion, the Cassard was reintegrated into the central Navy, and selected to garrison the troublesome Champagne system. NAME
[ARCHIVE] Second Gallic Civil War - Part I

504693
NAME
710-716 AGS (794-800 AS) -- Some historians name the year 798 as the beginning of the Second Gallic Civil War, for that was the year when the Council acted openly against the Gallic Army for the first time. Yet it is commonly considered that the war started in 794 AS on Planet Marne located in the Champagne system, when a massive rebellion broke out in three out of five of Marne's prime industrial centers. The rebellion was apparently well-prepared and organized. Gallic media reported that many rebel commanders were former military officers or even professional criminals hired to fulfill this task. Those reports were denounced by the Council, but it is apparent that there were a number of experienced soldiers and military commanders among the rebels. Initial tactics involved taking control over the main Marne cities and industrial facilities with minimal destruction and civilian casualties.\n\nAt fist, the rebellion was an overall success: police forces in the cities were defeated, as well as army detachments recently deployed within the cities to preserve order. However, most Gallic ground troops resided on well-defended bases in desolate areas of the planet. Their resistance was much heavier than the rebels first expected. Despite numerical superiority, rebels were heavily outgunned and could not establish control over the planet's terrain. At first, the government hesitated to use heavy weaponry against the cities. Rebels used this time to reinforce their defenses and capture space ports which were used to deliver weaponry and reinforcements. Light military vehicles and artillery were mainly supplied by the Council, while Gallic Brigands supplied firearms and ammunition. During this time many volunteers from the Council, various pirate groups, and even citizens from other planets joined the rebellion. The space around the planet was controlled by the Gallic Navy at that time, but the Navy apparently underestimated the amount of help the rebels were receiving from off-planet. Patrols assigned by the Navy were not enough to isolate the planet.\n\nAttempts of the army to capture any of the rebel-controlled cities and settlements failed, much like the rebels themselves failed to take control over military objects. In the middle of 798 AS, a large army of over 110,000 troops was assembled in the Core Worlds and prepared for transport to Marne. Only about 45,000 made it through, for the Council finally interfered and attacked incoming Navy forces near Reims station and planet Sezanne. These were the first of many space fights that occurred during the war. The Navy was caught completely unprepared, and had to retreat. The Council failed to destroy any of the transports carrying the troops, but prevented them from proceeding to Marne.\n\nThe ambush near Reims happened before the Council forces landed on the planet, although some sources state otherwise. The Gallic Army, reinforced by fresh manpower, launched a massive attack against the rebels, striking on every front. After that, the rebels were probably aware that the Council would arrive in a matter of days, and threw all their forces to defend space ports where Council transports could land. The Council, however, could not break through the planetary blockade soon enough: they had to capture Reims Station in order prevent the Gallic Navy from striking from behind. Once Reims was captured and reinforced with heavy anti-capital-ship weaponry, the Council fleet proceeded to planet Marne. Attacking forces of the Gallic Royals were scattered by the newly arrived Council units, but resistance did not end until 801 AS when it was perfectly clear that the Gallic Navy would not be able to break through Council defenses, at least for the next several years.

The number reportedly includes a few civilians as well.\n\nIn the same year, one of the most controversial events of the whole Second War followed. Gap Station, which occupied a crucial location on the route from Burgundy into Languedoc, was attacked by the Council. Because destroying the massive and heavily guarded station that had many civilian inhabitants was not an option for the attackers, their goal was to drop marines within the station and capture it with minimal casualties. Once again, the plans of the Council became known to the Navy command, and Gallic Army detachments were brought to defend the station. Eventually, a large Council fleet arrived to the Gap area, neutralized station defenses and launched dropships. Fighting within the station lasted for more than 4 days and ended only when all Council landing troops were defeated. The victory cost both sides greatly, with over 400 killed and many more wounded. While the Gallic soldiers were stationed near the airlocks to prevent a new assault, a large Royal Navy fleet finally arrived to breach the blockade. Before retreating, desperate Council ships launched a final missile attack against all Gap's airlocks, which could have potentially resulted in the station de-pressurizing. Gap Station's engineers had to seal the inner airlocks before the Gallic soldiers could escape; trapped outside, they were blown into space and perished. Very few of the military and police personnel survived the attack, and civilian casualties were low only by a miracle.\n\nWith no chance to capture Briancon or Gap stations located in the central part of Languedoc, the Council chose the tactic of sporadic raids to distract Navy and Police patrols from outer regions of the system that were used to relocate Council fleets into Languedoc. By the end of 812 AS, Council had built multiple storage banks and small repair facilities near the Jump Gate path between Languedoc and Languedoc. Most of those facilities were equipped with simple but deadly self-destruct mechanisms that activated when Navy or Police ships were approaching. The next year, an offensive against Languedoc was set to begin.\n\nMeanwhile, the situation in Burgundy and Lorraine was under dense control of the Navy. Security of the two systems was declared the highest priority for the GRN, and most available forces in the Gallic Border Worlds were ordered to defend them. Attempts to breach defenses in Lorraine failed repeatedly, and Council presence in the system remained minimal. Maquis secured a small base in one of the Lorraine asteroid fields, but they could do nothing with the Navy fleets and mostly concentrated on smuggling and piracy against small corporate shipments.

[ARCHIVE] Second Gallic Civil War - Part IV

504699
NAME
729-731 AGS (813-815 AS) -- The Languedoc offensive caught the Gallic Royal Navy completely unprepared. Apparently, their previous means of gathering intelligence on the Council failed them. A massive armada of Council capital ships came into Languedoc directly through the Jump Gate, which was not guarded by any Navy ships at that time. At the same time, hundreds of Council fighters began advancing from the Lozere asteroid field in Languedoc. Local Navy detachments delayed capital ships advancing to Remoulins, which gave the station's inhabitants time to evacuate. It was rumored that the Council allowed this intentionally to avoid civilian casualties, for most of Remoulins' inhabitants were miners employed by Gallic Metal Service.\n\nThe decisive battle for Languedoc took place in the middle of 813 AS near Remoulins. The station was empty at that time, and during the fight one of its outer storage tanks filled with explosive fuel was damaged by battleship fire. The tank detonated shortly afterwards, destroying the whole station. It remains unknown which ship damaged the tank, since Council and GRN used similar types of weaponry in this battle. It is also unknown if it was done intentionally or not. However, it is certain that the explosion helped the Council to achieve a victory, for Royal Navy cruisers that used the station as cover from Council battleship fire were crippled in the explosion and became easy prey for Council bombers.\n\nNimes Station was the next target, and in 814 AS the Council attempted to use the same tactic that failed with Gap Station. This time, however, previous mistakes were taken into account. The Council made use of inside support from civilians loyal to its cause. While Council fleets were stationed next to Remoulins' wreck and Nimes was preparing for an assault from space, a group of Council special operatives breached the station through a maintenance airlock that was left unguarded. Before local Police and Army guards could organize any resistance, the Council took over control of the station's life support, computer mainframes, internal and external defensive systems. Later, a Council fleet arrived, and station defenders had no other choice but to surrender. With minimal casualties from both sides (4 men killed), this operation is known as the most bloodless in the whole Second Gallic Civil War.\n\nThe Council offensive on Planet Quillan was the second planetary operation of the war. Capturing the planet was vital for the final success in breaching the mine field defenses. Breaching planetary defenses was a relatively easy task. However, after Council ground forces landed on the planet in the end of 815 AS, they discovered that a Gallic army of 90,000 was stationed on the planet and prepared to defend its settlements and factories. Outnumbered, the Council forces had to fortify their positions and prepare for a lengthy fight for the planet's surface.\n\nThis moment was crucial for the whole war. The Royal Navy was planning to launch a counter-assault against Council in Languedoc. If the Navy's assault was successful, the Council would lose ground in Languedoc and fail to breach the mine field. TheCouncil suffered heavy casualties, and launching a new offensive was not an option until losses were recovered. During that time, the Navy could concentrate all forces near Champagne and take back the system, undoing all progress that the rebels had made since the start of the war.

[ARCHIVE] Second Gallic Civil War - Part V

504701

732-733 AGS (816-817 AS) -- In 816 AS, the Council had no option other than to request support from the Maquis, who, in turn, rallied their allies in the Core Worlds to attack Royal Navy from behind. A large part of Montpellier station itself was destroyed in a suicide attack by a Council battleship packed with thermonuclear explosives, with most station defenders killed in the explosion or shortly afterwards. Path to the mines was now clear, and Council moved forward to destroy the mines and create a large corridor that would allow all ships, even the largest ones, to pass through without being at risk of mine explosions. After the path was ready, the Council started to build a new space station on the other side, baring a symbolic name of Reunion.\n\nAt the same time, using the aid of local Maquis and several Junker turncoats, the Council started to set up a covert path within the Lorraine mine field. With the Royal Navy relocating all available forces to advance into Languedoc, the part of Lorraine that was far from the Champagne Jump Gate was left loosely defended. Finally, by the end of 817 AS the path to the Outcast system of Omicron Tau was revealed. Unlike the route in Languedoc mines, Lorraine's path was narrow and dangerous, having no navigation buoys nor other ways that could help to make this route safer. It is still likely that it will be discovered by Gallic Royal Navy patrols in a matter of months, and will possibly be remined.

Please stay tuned and await for further announcements\n\n-- Burgundy Royal Navy Headquarters, Planet Nevers, August 17, 733 AGS

504760
NAME
[733 AGS] The 2nd Gallic War: True Goals of the Council

504761
NAME
BRIANCON -- 733 AGS -- The so-called Second Gallic Civil War that was inspired by the Council two decades ago is nowhere near its ending. The Council, the powerful and wealthy group formed mainly by Royal Navy and Royal Police deserters, and financed by semi-legal businesses and criminal cartels of the Core Worlds, is sometimes described as a revolutionary movement. Yet, through the course of the war the Gallic media collected evidence that Council is nowadays more like a state within a state, having its own bureaucracy, enforcement agencies, and even newly established oligarchy that came into fortune due to the war.\n\nThe Council leaders claim that their goal is to change the government of Gallia and overthrow the monarchy, in addition to breaking the isolation of Gallia from the rest of Sirius worlds. According to our today's expert Robert Broussard, Doctor of Economy and senior consultant of Solar Engineering and Ile-de-France Shipping, the Council never had an intention to overthrow the New Paris monarchy. "Our information on the Council agenda is mainly based on their own public announcements and press releases. Yet, New Paris is so far from the Gallic Border Worlds that the Council will not be able to overtake the Core Worlds by force, even if all Border Worlds fall under their supreme rule," - Broussard says, - "On New Paris and other prominent worlds of Gallia, public support for the warlike actions of the Council is relatively low, and the Council is aware that the chances to inspire revolts in the heart of our nation are very slim."\n\nIndependent analysts estimate black market operations in Gallia rising by 150%% during the last 30 years. At the same time, frequency of pirate attacks had risen twice in the Core Worlds, and more than three times in the Border Worlds. This unprecedented wave of piracy occured mainly because of the demand for various smuggled goods that the Council generates, and because of the overall chaos caused by the war. Royal Police was caught unprepared by this new dangerous tendency, unable to defend corporate and civilian shipments. The pirate groups are expected to grow even larger now that the path to Sirius was breached by the Council in Languedoc. Being able to take advantage of this new development, pirate groups like the Unione Corse, Gallic Brigands, and Maquis now plan their expansion into Sirius, searching for new markets and recruiting more pilots.\n\nThe Council supports those pirate groups almost openly, in return for their help against the Royal Navy. Sporadic raids of Brigands and Maquis never cause significant losses, but play a crucial role in delaying Navy operations against the Council. Almost every asteroid field and nebula in Gallia is now swarmed with ships of various unlawful groups. It remains unknown for how much longer the Council resistance will continue, but it is already evident that there are forces within the Council and within the pirate groups interested in using the war as a source of income. For the Council leadership, political struggle and the well being of their own people appears to be less important than gaining personal wealth and power. This is the reason why the Council would never support any peace negotiation initiatives.

504762
NAME
[733 AGS] Path into Sirius Opened by the Council

504763
NAME
DIJON -- 733 AGS -- Shortly after the path into Sirius was opened by advancing forces of the Council, a large number of unidentified ships were detected in the Languedoc and Languedoc systems. Disturbing reports come from Lorraine where powerful and agressive ships of unknown configuration were reported engaged in several fights with the Royal Navy not far from the Luneville Guard Station. During last week, several sightings of the as of yet unidentified ships were reported in the Burgundy system as well.\n\nThe mine paths created by the Council are narrow and dangerous, and very few ships of heavier class can pass through them. Newcomers from Sirius do not appear to be organized as one power and belong to a number of various groups and factions. Gallic officials are now collecting information on the factions that dispatched those ships, their possible goals, and level of technology. Before this information becomes publically available for ship pilots, we advise civilian and Royal Police pilots to avoid any contacts with the newcomers, reporting all unidentified contacts to the local Navy patrols as soon as possible.\n\nIt already became known that some pirate bases offer docking and repair services to ships from Sirius. The newcomers also appear to have access to our Trade Lane and Jump Gate initiation procedures. To secure the Core Worlds and prepare for establishing official contacts with the other Sirius nations, Gates leading to them are now blocked for any and all ships. Gallic Royal Police and Gallic Royal Navy apologize for the inconvenience to passengers and shipping companies, but maintain that this precaution is necessary for reasons of national security.

504829
NAME
[817 AS] The Real Reason Behind The Hudson War

504830
NAME
NEW BERLIN -- 817 AS -- It has been a few months now since Liberty aligned forces shot at Rheinland ships in the independent worlds between the two houses, in an attempt to punish Rheinland for what they claim is "a lack of financial and political responsibility of House Rheinland to House Liberty". The conflict has since escalated into an all-out border war slowly being pushed toward the Hamburg system. But is simple revenge and looting the only reason Liberty is attacking Rheinland? It would appear not.\n\nIt is not news that Liberty is fortifying the rather backwater New Hampshire system, with fleet movements large enough to be detected easily. At first thought to be a deterrent force, analysts soon began to suspect otherwise as new information was made available by sources within the Marinenachrichtendienst. About a week ago the Rheinland Military has scored a searing success against the Liberty Navy, ambushing and disabling an entire patrol, including a gunboat class vessel. Upon boarding the craft, its neural net codes were used to access the Liberty Navy internal network from which partial plans for a larger scheme were recovered - including the idea that Liberty pushed for the war in Hudson to detract attention from a different target, deeper within Rheinland.\n\nAlthough the true target of Liberty remains unknown, the Rheinland Military is now well aware of the possibility of an encirclement in Hamburg and has begun gathering forces within the Bremen system to respond to any attempts at a Libertonian strike. One thing is clear however: if Liberty is willing to go to war over whatever they are seeking, Rheinland must do all it can to deny them their prize.

504831
NAME
[817 AS] Liberty Companies Maintain a Stake in Rheinland

504832
NAME
NEW BERLIN -- 817 AS -- Unilateral Libertonian aggression against Rheinland continues to dominate the Sirius-wide news, facing the Berlin Reichstag not only with military choices, but also important and difficult questions concerning the nation's economy. Both major and minor Liberty companies with holdings in Rheinland space have been continuing their withdrawal back to New York, leaving their assets mostly frozen and protected by Interspace Commerce. This does not include Synth Foods Inc. however, which is determined to keep its stranglehold on Stuttgart strong and unquestionable. Several parties in the Reichstag have described this as a move of economic warfare on the part of Liberty, and have asked for a vote towards the immediate nationalisation of Planet Stuttgart - a motion which was surprisingly denied by Chancellor Reinhardt himself, quoting financial claims by Interspace and Synth Foods as the reason behind his decision. While there is speculation that this move may have been prompted by different motives, many economists in both Rheinland and Kusari disagree.\n\n"Rheinland in its present state is very fragile. If we were to make moves against Synth Foods now, the IC would certainly demand compensation per the contract we agreed to with Liberty over a century ago, and that move would devastate the currency by increasing our already considerable national debt. We would find ourselves needing to borrow money from Kusari just to keep the government afloat, and at that point Liberty could simply withdraw its Navy and wait for Rheinland to dissolve on its own." - says Jonas Koehler, chief advisor to the Minister of Finance.\n\nWhen asked why exactly did Liberty not follow this move in the first place instead of aggressively pursuing a shooting war, Herr Koehler mentioned the exact reason being unknown at the time, but also said that "Liberty officials are likely hoping to force us to capitulate without collapsing our economy, and having to invest even more money into restarting it afterwards". This would mean that Liberty is in fact hoping for a quick and decisive victory.

504833
NAME
[817 AS] Rheinland Patriots Prepare for War

504834
NAME
BRUCHSAL -- 817 AS -- With the first invaders at the gates of Rheinland, the prospect of the unification of our homeland against a common enemy stands strong. Many idealist Bundschuh party members have left Frankfurt to help defend the border from the imperialist tendencies of Liberty. The Liberty Navy has since reported increased attacks against their convoys and patrols, something they dare not attribute to a political organisation such as the Bundschuh out of fear of other Rheinland revolutionaries joining in the fight.\n\nA few weeks ago a successful buildup has managed to reactivate the old Bundschuh base in Bremen without intervention on the part of the Rheinland Military residing there. It is unlikely that they are unaware of the situation, as reports of skirmishes between the Libertonians and the Bundschuh along the Hamburg and Bremen border arrive in Rheinland at a steady basis, meanwhile the formerly dense Bundschuh attacks against most military targets have severely lessened during the last weeks.\n\nThe question that the people of Rheinland now ask themselves is: Is this the day on which we put all our differences aside in order to battle a common enemy?

504835
NAME
[817 AS] Red Hessian Expansion Still Under Way

504836
NAME
VOGTLAND -- 817 AS -- Despite the increased Wilde attacks and the prospect of war in Rheinland, the Red Hessians still pour significant resources into their expansion in the Omega edge worlds, especially the Omega-47 flank. In a recent unexpected development the Hessians have begun reactivating their old diamond smuggling routes to Hudson and the rest of Liberty via the Unioners and Liberty Rogues. These diamonds however are unlike any other ever encountered. Their reddish tint and plentiful applications serve as both a political statement and a lucrative source of income for the Red Hessian movement. Some believe that this is connected to their recent build-up in the edge systems, however no such rumours have been confirmed so far.\n\nWhile the corporate backed Rheinland government lobbies Kusari to outlaw this new commodity in order to assure continued income for Daumann, opportunists flock to Hessian bases with the market in Liberty standing wide open, as the house stands in their refusal to declare it as contraband. Whether future political developments will change this attitude is unknown, but the Red Hessians plan to use the resulting profit to further their goals for as long as they can.

Thanks to this process, it is possible to predict that the tunnel system currently spans only a fraction of the planet's surface, and the number of Nomads living there likely does not exceed a couple of thousand. However, if this number were to increase, it is quite possible that their means of sustaining themselves would deplete the planet's core rapidly, with some Core analysts predicting that it might cool down in a matter of mere years if more than 80% of the planet's surface shows signs of Nomad infestation.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Order operatives who have investigated these recent developments and explored the cavern system reported that most of the space below the surface is dedicated to massive caverns in which Nomad ships are nestled into the stone walls, resembling a beehive structure. Through this, the Order was able to deduce that most of the Nomads living on Moros are in a state of hibernation, possibly to reduce the amount of energy necessary to sustain themselves and thereby put less strain on the planet's core.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

[817 AS] Bigger Things At Stake

NAME
ARRANMORE -- 817 AS -- Kusari wastes no time in smashing the broken Bretonian Armed Forces before them. They pushed through Tau-31, ignored Harris and went straight for Leeds. Molly leaders are well aware of the danger this poses, but it appears like Bretonia is set to fail even despite Molly help at Harris. Newcastle Molly clans are expected to continue helping the Armed Forces behind enemy lines, and chances that such behaviour will be discouraged in any way by any clan leaders are quite slim.

505485
NAME
[817 AS] A New House Unveiled

505486
NAME
BRUCHSAL -- 817 AS -- Our extensive information networks have today provided us with news that can only be described as unprecedented. A new House has been revealed by a group calling themselves "The Council", supposedly a revolutionary group fighting against a corrupt government and corporations - just like ourselves. While brothers in arms are equally welcome regardless if they operate on the other side of Sirius, the rest of their message was far bleaker: the House government they fight against is about to send an assault of grand scale into Sirius with intent to conquer. Kusari seems to be right in its path, and Bretonia soon after. Only time will tell however if such an action will even take place.

505487
NAME
[817 AS] Down With The Outcast Alliance!

505488
NAME
VOGTLAND -- 817 AS -- The Outcasts finally reveal their treachery. We have suspected them of infiltration attempts in our movement, hoping to gain a foothold in Rheinland through which they can peddle their drugs to our society. Groups within the Red Hessians have been working silently against this, but required proof to be sure of the Outcasts' intentions. This proof was delivered after a transport carrying cargo of advanced weaponry was attacked and destroyed by the Outcast Reapers of Sirius wing. The Revolutionary Council immediately declared all standing agreements between the Outcasts and Hessians as null and void. All Outcasts found within Rheinland or its border systems are to be removed from those systems. All Cardamine transports within Rheinland are now a target of opportunity. The Red Hessians will not be enslaved to drug lords, let this be a message that proves it!

505489
NAME
[817 AS] Red Hessians Break Alliance

505490
NAME
MALTA -- 817 AS -- After the success that our alliance with groups across the colonies brought in eradicating Corsair influence outside of the edge worlds, it seemed rather unlikely that any group would be unsatisfied with the result. And yet the Red Hessians, always blocking the flow of Cardamine into Rheinland, continued to look at us with stark suspicion and seeming disgust. Recently this disgust turned into outright hatred as the Red Hessian leadership unjustly blamed the Outcasts for an attack on one of their transports deep within the Omega systems. No Outcast pilots have or ever will operate in that area, but the Hessians will hear nothing of it. We have anticipated such a scenario a long time ago however and arrangements have been made to ensure that the Outcasts do not lose any business elsewhere as a result of this.

Our heroic Navy is already preparing to put an end to this stockpile to ensure that no side in Sirius has access to any kind of weapons of mass destruction that may be gained from knowledge of such forbidden tech.

NAME
Planet New Paris

506101
INFOCARD
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>DIAMETER: 12,418 km</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>MASS: 5.95 x 10e24 kg</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>TERRAIN: Terrestrial</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>TEMPERATURE: -66°C to 68°C</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>ESCAPE VELOCITY: 11.28 km/sec</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

506102
INFOCARD
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>New Paris was the first planet colonized by the Gallic Sleeper Ship's arrival in 84 AS (0 AGS). Ecologically, the world was similar to Earth's Carboniferous period. Vast forests cover the equatorial and moderate regions but only a few large animal species in habit them. Oxygen concentration on New Paris is similar to human-inhabited Earth, hovering at 24 percent. Unlike the Carboniferous period, which had an Oxygen content of almost 40 percent, therefore large insect species didn't develop, leaving room for smaller amphibians and small avian dinosaurs to evolve. Cold continental areas were sparsely inhabited and had no large flora. Oceanic wildlife is extremely rich with a wide variety of species; most do not bear resemblance to any known Earth animals. The planet's climate was similar to Earth, with temperatures of 60°C at the equator and dropping below -60°C at the poles.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>New Paris has undergone several periods of development, starting with numerous isolated colonies. Soon afterwards, large cities evolved from these, and food demand forced them to exploit huge areas of land to plant crops and raise animals brought from Earth. In many areas, indigenous wildlife was fully replaced with domesticated fauna and flora from Earth. Rapid industrial growth resulted in severe pollution that still affects certain areas of the planet. Circa 200 AGS, the planet's population neared 5 million and large urban centers emerged in moderate climates near natural harbors. Those centers were named after old Paris districts.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>The population grew steadily and reached 1 billion by 600 AGS. Millions relocated off-world, with massive relocation campaigns taking place to populate worlds with huge resource deposits and industrial capacity. Apart from the relocation programs, many people left New Paris to find a better standard of living and capturing their inner pioneer spirit. Sadly, New Paris gradually became the most expensive planet to live in all of Gallia.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Ecology issues forced the removal of heavy industry away from New Paris to space stations in Ile-de-France and beyond. The few remaining ancient factories now serve as museums displaying impressive industrial landmarks similar to 21st century Earth. Currently, the planet is considered to be one of the most comfortable places to live in all of Gallia. Offices of the Royal Government and Royal Chancellery, as well as the High Courts and the Parliament, were located on New Paris.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>By the end of the Second Gallic Civil War, the Council's fleet reached New Paris and prepared for a final battle against the remains of the Royal Navy's home fleet. By that point, the King, his court retainers, closest followers and various nobles had already evacuated and were on their way to the Gallic Hebrides. Thus cooler heads prevailed and the Royal Navy chose to surrender, and a ceasefire was issued throughout Gallia. The historic seat of the Gallic monarchy was now at the Council's mercy.</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>However, higher planet side living standards, proximity to the Monarchy and decades of ardent propaganda ensured that the Parisians had a low opinion of the Council and its ideology. Consequently, the provisional government of Ile-de-France declined to join the newly-formed Republic, which in turn wasn't willing to start a new era with a bloodbath.</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>Instead, New Paris declared itself an autonomous state despite possessing little to defend itself. The reason behind this decision ties into Ile-de-France's considerable strategic import. Namely, significant industrial and shipbuilding capacity and enormous agricultural production capabilities ensure that the system could be entirely self-sufficient. Also Ile-de-France is located at the heart of the Gallic lane network, guaranteeing it freedom of navigation and the ability to shut down trade in any of the Confederate states by deactivating the corresponding gates.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>This also made Ile-de-France the most logical choice for a neutral meeting ground between the leaders and representatives of all Gallic states. This summit, known as the Parisian Assembly, is where the Confederacy was born, out of need for Gallia to remain united against internal divisions and against external threats. It was also the Assembly that outlawed weapons of mass destruction throughout Gallia, banning the Royal Navy's WMDs and largest ships from its space.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Nowadays, the Assembly hosts regular meetings of Gallia's elite. Each constituent state of the Confederacy has permanent representation on New Paris, and some Sirian entities already have their own embassies planet side. The Assembly presides over all aspects of Confederate-level governing; funding specific projects, maintaining infrastructure, allocating supplies, regulating tariffs and providing arbitration in disputes between the Gallic states. In return, said states are required to provide support to Ile-de-France, in the form of taxes, manpower and ships. These contributions are used to fuel both the Gendarmerie and the new Confederate Defense Force.</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

510846
NAME
[828 AS] - Shigeakiki. What is it?

510847
NAME
AINU -- 828 AS -- A brand new kind of drug enters the market today. This new Cardamine derived stimulant is composed of multiple herbs and chemicals and is designed to enhance the performance of Chrysanthemum pilots during combat in high risk encounters against the Kusari Police and Navy. "This stimulant affects the nervous system which results in heightened senses. This can lead to oversensitivity. One of the most common symptoms is light sensitivity. Darkened visors or sunglasses can alleviate this." says Ishida Morika, a spokesperson for the Golden Chrysanthemum cell that developed the drug.\n\n"These, like all effects of the stimulant, last roughly an hour and leave no permanent alterations. The only permanent effect is Cardamine addiction. None of the other components have addictive qualities." Ishida goes to elaborate further and states that "The full formula is a closely guarded secret and shall not be made public." This new drug is currently focused mainly for the Kusari market, but Ishida has not ruled out the possibility of expanding it further.

Thought forever lost, rumours of similar vessels have been reported by Trade Lane ambush survivors in the years 807 to 815 AS, under the employ of a fraternity of underworld organisations, including the Lane Hackers, the Liberty Insurgency, the precursors to the Natio Octavarium, amongst others. However, these fabled imitations never matched the technical sophistication of the original design. With the occupation of the entire Vespucci system in 818 AS by Hellfire forces, it is assumed by the historical record that the remaining spyglass retrofits were converted into the modern Arbiter electronics warfare dreadnoughts that remain under limited commission by the Insurgency, although rumours of spyglass sightings persist in all manner of conspiracies and tall tales.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT> LIDAR indicates a seventy-six-point two percent probability that the target vessel is a descendent, sister ship, or copy, of the LNS Ragnarok, however, the propulsion, weapons systems, and external hull of the target appear to be of an unknown Rheinland design, a chimera of conventionally incompatible spacecraft architectures and technological ancestries. .</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT> Massive interference detected. Advise avoiding further contact."</TEXT><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

Due to the fuel being only available in significant quantities within Gallia, the engines have no export market to speak of. This engine is intended for use on gunboats.</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT> Top Speed (theoretical): 500</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT> Energy Drain / sec: 0</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><POP/></RDL>

NAME
ARRANMORE -- 831 AS -- Bretonia has finally been expelled from Dublin! Molly forces across Bretonia were gathered to Dublin in preparation for the greatest battle in our history. Agents aboard Graves Station laid the groundwork for the Second Revolt among a crew that was outraged by tyranny and mistreatment. Occupying the Essex's attention took the lives of many brave fighters, but allowed a strike force led by the Destroyer Shillelagh to penetrate the Jump Gate's remaining defenses and cripple it. With Graves destroyed, the Essex fled. This fight was the single bloodiest day in the Mollys' 80-year history, but it has won us liberation.

BATTLESHIP ESSEX -- 833 AS -- A military tribunal has found Admiral James Byng guilty of failing to do his utmost to prevent the loss of Dublin and the New London Jump Gate. The charges concerned the deployment and disposition of forces under Byng's command, the botched boarding of Graves Station, and his order to retreat from the system. The admiralty judges commuted a capital sentence to dishonorable discharge, noting exemplary service during the Gallic War. Representatives speaking on Byng's behalf decried the tribunal as a sham, claiming he was being scapegoated for broader failures. The Battleship Essex continues to maintain a blockade of Dublin, with orders to prevent smuggling in the Cumbria Asteroid Field.

524373
NAME
[831 AS] Gruesome reports as Dublin falls

524374
NAME
Grotesque broadcasts have issued from Graves Station after Molly saboteurs captured the base. The terrorists filmed the execution of senior BMM officials with pickaxes, murdering station administrator Dame Helen Raleigh and maintenance chief Harland Streeve. The Battleship Essex was quick to respond to the atrocities, dispatching a boarding force to retake Graves. Unwilling to face justice for their crimes, the hijackers detonated the station, murdering all aboard. Simultaneous suicide attacks against the New London Jump Gate forced the Essex's withdrawal. The Government has stressed that this withdrawal is temporary, and that a blockade will be imposed while forces are assembled to pacify the system.

524375
NAME
[831 AS] Bretonia withdraws from Dublin system

524376
NAME
WATERLOO -- 831 AS -- Markets are down across Sirius after the twin shocks of The Blackout and Bretonia's retreat from Dublin. Molly separatists have destroyed Graves Station and the New London Jump Gate, forcing Bretonia from the system. The separatists declared their rule over Dublin and its Gold, while Bretonia has imposed a strict blockade. With Gold production effectively ceased, legal supplies are limited to Bretonian stockpiles. Technology, manufacturing, and shipbuilding sectors are all expected to be adversely impacted. Interspace Commerce has downgraded Bretonia's sovereign credit rating, citing increased risk of default following the loss of Dublin's critical state revenue.

524377
NAME
[831 AS] Bretonian focus turns on Mollys

524378
NAME
SHEFFIELD -- 831 AS -- The Bretonia Police Authority has announced the eradication of the Molly movement is their top priority. Following the loss of the Dublin system, the dangerous terrorist movement has leaped to the top of Bretonia's most wanted board. Bounties on Molly terrorists have doubled, with Guild Hunters flocking to the beleaguered House. Sheffield Guildmaster Tina Hale commented that, "these are Edge World rates for domestic threats." Despite that, prospective Hunters should be cautious, as the Mollys are notoriously cunning fighters. The crackdown appears to be having some effect, as reports of Molly attacks on shipping in Cambridge and Newcastle have already fallen.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?><RDL><PUSH/><TEXT>CLASS: Martel</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>GRAVITY: None</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>DOCKING: No</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>AMENITIES: No</TEXT><PARA/><TEXT>CREW: 0</TEXT><PARA/><PARA/><TEXT>Montpellier Fortress was a defensive installation built by the Gallic Royal Navy in 651 AGS (735 AS). Constructed to deploy and then secure the minefield that blocked access to the Orkney system, it boasted a fearsome garrison and extensive defenses. For almost a century, Montpellier remained a state secret, visited only by Huissier spies launching long range missions into Sirius. In 733 AGS (817 AS), Montpellier and its guard fleet were cut off by The Council’s occupation of Languedoc. 550127
NAME
[827 AS] Unknown disease causing havoc in Nu

550128
NAME
Following a range of the local personnel falling ill after returning from the Bikini Debris Field and planet Marshall, the medical team attached to the exploration team in Omicron Nu requested the authorities to temporarily limit the traffic from and into the system and establish quarantine.\n\nThe first signs of the disease appeared soon after the planetfall on Marshall and since then the malaise spread to over 30 crew members. The cause of the illness is unknown and being researched by the medical scientists aboard "Oregon". According to the preliminary analysis, the disease is highly infectious and requires limitation of free travel in the area until the cause and/or appropriate treatment is found. One of the hypothesis blames the malaise on intensive solar flares of the three-star system and bursts of solar radiation, yet other scientists rebuke the assumption as incompetent due to the found infectious nature of the disease.\n\nIt is not the first case of xeno-disease encountered throughout the colonisation of Sirius. Many local bacteria and even viruses caused a lot of trouble for the early settlers yet have largely been subdued due to the advances in heuristic pharmacology. Cryer officials have issued a statement that a test medication is already underway and Omicron Nu restriction could be lifted soon. For now, Liberty authorities advise to avoid visiting the Omicron Nu system and remind of persecution under the Law of the Republic of Liberty in case of violation of the standing quarantine.

550129
NAME
[800 AS] The Birth of the Mollys

550130
NAME
Battleship Hood -- 800 AS -- The history of the Mollys is intimately linked with that of Dublin. During the height of the Dublin Gold rush, the field manager in charge of the primary large-scale corporate operation in the system was a ruthless tyrant named Sir Edmund Graves. Graves pushed the miners to the limit in the name of profits, causing many unnecessary deaths. Greed combined with absolute control had proved too tempting. He and his lieutenants began skimming a percentage off the Gold take on a weekly basis. \n\nThe miners were pushed harder to cover up the shortfall in shipments back to New London, and the situation became critical. The Founders Day Revolt, as it came to be known, occurred on the annual national Bretonian holiday in 752 AS that commemorated the original founding of New London centuries before. The workers mutinied, executed Graves and his compatriots, and took control of the mining ships Endeavor and Glorious.\n\nThe Bretonian military response was swift and furious. Bretonian gunboats arrived shortly, and in the ensuing battle, destroyed the Endeavor and its mutineers. They pursued the Glorious across the system into a dense field, where they stumbled into a large, explosive booby trap set by the fleeing miners. One gunboat was destroyed; several were damaged. \n\nThe Battleship Hood was rushed in from New London to restore order. This proved to be the last straw. The remaining miners in the system declared their independence from the ruthless oppressor, and began a long guerrilla war of attrition against the Bretonian government. \n\nIn the most famous incident, they disabled the Hood's engines with a huge mine and set off a large chain-reaction of explosions in the ship's aft. The repairs required were extensive and could only be undertaken at the Southampton shipyard. Unfortunately, the ship was considered too unstable to undertake the journey back through the Jump Gate. It was officially abandoned and stripped of most weaponry, engines, and sensitive electronics. The ship was later reoccupied by the IMG and now serves as the only Freeport within House frontiers. \n\nDespite few tangible victories in their effort to free the Dublin system from control of the Bretonian government, they've still managed to fight a vastly superior military force to a near standstill. The Armed Forces patrols from the Essex usually only respond when the Mollys make attacks on the BMM operation near Graves and elsewhere the system.
